jobs.description:
Coletar, higienizar, estruturar e gerenciar bases de dados da área técnica e pós-vendas, garantindo a qualidade e consistência das informações (Data Quality), além de desenvolver rotinas automatizadas e painéis de suporte para otimizar a tomada de decisão operacional e estratégica.

Criar e manter relatórios diários/semanais e painéis visuais básicos de acompanhamento (Power BI). ##### **Studies**

### **About BRITÂNIA**

A nossa história começou em 1956, em Curitiba, e, desde então, crescemos junto com as famílias brasileiras. De fogões a eletroportáteis que conquistaram o Brasil, estamos presentes em 98% dos lares do país. Mas, além dos produtos, o que nos move é o nosso orgulho em “britaniar”, deixando os momentos do dia a dia mais leves, práticos e felizes.
  
  
Hoje, somos mais de 10.000 colaboradores atuando em fábricas, centros de distribuição, showrooms e escritórios, que carregam nossa essência: criatividade que facilita a vida, bom humor que aproxima e cuidado que acolhe. Aqui, cada pessoa importa e a diversidade é o que fortalece o nosso time e nos impulsiona a avançar juntos.
  
  
Na Britânia, evoluir faz parte da jornada. Temos programas de estágio que abrem portas, escolas de operações, iniciativas de desenvolvimento de lideranças e programas de reconhecimento para quem faz a diferença. Com o InovaBri, cada ideia ganha vida e ajuda a reinventar o nosso jeito de fazer sempre melhor. E porque acreditamos que “britaniar” também é cuidar do mundo, investimos em sustentabilidade e apoiamos projetos sociais, culturais e esportivos que impactam comunidades e inspiram novas histórias.
  
  
Fazer parte da Britânia é vestir a camisa de uma marca brasileira que, há quase 70 anos, cresce com orgulho, valoriza talentos e acredita no propósito de melhorar a vida das pessoas com proximidade e cuidado.

jobs.title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Jr - Governança de Dados e IA
jobs.description:
### **Resumo da vaga:**

A **Extractta** está em busca de um(a) **Data Engineer Júnior** para atuar em um projeto estratégico em uma **grande instituição do segmento financeiro**, integrando a equipe de Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial.

O(a) profissional terá atuação voltada à **governança de agentes de IA Generativa**, contribuindo para a definição de padrões, processos, controles e guardrails que garantam a utilização segura, responsável e eficiente de soluções de inteligência artificial no ambiente corporativo.

Buscamos um perfil com **conhecimento técnico do ecossistema de IA Generativa**, visão analítica e capacidade de apoiar e conduzir iniciativas de governança, promovendo a integração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.

### **Responsabilidades e atribuições:**

* Atuar nas iniciativas de **governança de agentes de Inteligência Artificial**, contribuindo para a definição e implementação de padrões, processos e guardrails corporativos.
* Conduzir e apoiar alinhamentos com áreas de negócio, engenharia, arquitetura, segurança da informação e compliance.
* Avaliar riscos, viabilidade e aderência de soluções de IA às políticas internas, aos requisitos de segurança e às regulamentações aplicáveis.
* Estruturar e acompanhar controles para utilização de agentes de IA, assegurando **segurança, privacidade, rastreabilidade e monitoramento**.
* Contribuir para a definição de padrões de utilização de **LLMs, APIs, integrações, chaves de acesso e credenciais**.
* Documentar casos de uso, riscos, limitações, responsabilidades e diretrizes relacionadas às soluções de inteligência artificial.
* Acompanhar a adoção de soluções de IA Generativa, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e promovendo boas práticas de **IA responsável**.
* Apoiar a tradução de necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos, controles e direcionamentos estruturados de governança.

### **Requisitos e qualificações:**

* Conhecimento do ecossistema de **Inteligência Artificial Generativa e modelos de linguagem (LLMs)**.
* Familiaridade com conceitos e tecnologias relacionados a:

  + **LLMs:** funcionamento, inferência, contexto e tokens.
  + **Agentes de IA:** funcionamento, orquestração e interação com ferramentas.
  + **MCP (Model Context Protocol):** protocolos de integração e comunicação com ferramentas e fontes de dados.
  + **Skills e Tools:** utilização de recursos e ferramentas por agentes inteligentes.
  + **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation):** técnicas de recuperação e contextualização de informações.
  + **Prompt Engineering:** estruturação de instruções e interações com modelos de IA.
* Conhecimento de conceitos de **governança de dados e IA**, incluindo políticas, controles e guardrails.
* Noções de gestão de riscos, segurança da informação, privacidade de dados e **LGPD**.
* Familiaridade com mecanismos de monitoramento, auditoria e rastreabilidade de soluções tecnológicas.
* Conhecimento sobre **APIs, integrações e gerenciamento de credenciais e chaves de acesso**.
* Capacidade de compreender necessidades de negócio e transformá-las em requisitos e direcionamentos estruturados.
* Boa capacidade de documentação técnica e organização de processos.

### **Desejáveis:**

* Vivência acadêmica ou profissional em projetos de **IA Generativa, agentes inteligentes ou governança de dados**.
* Familiaridade com plataformas e frameworks de IA, como Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain ou LangGraph.
* Conhecimento de boas práticas e frameworks de governança e IA responsável, como NIST AI RMF e ISO/IEC 42001.
* Experiência com iniciativas de segurança, compliance ou gestão de riscos tecnológicos.
* Conhecimento do ambiente regulatório e dos processos de instituições financeiras.
  

### **Benefícios:**

* Vale Alimentação e/ou Vale Refeição;
* Convênio Sesi e Sesc, oferecendo acesso a serviços de saúde, bem-estar e lazer;
* Parceria com Instituições de Ensino, com descontos exclusivos em cursos e programas educacionais;
* Auxílio para Certificações;
* Possibilidade de crescimento na empresa e de participação em projetos estratégicos;
* Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa do mercado em plena expansão.

Na **VONBZ**, somos arquitetos da evolução digital. Não contratamos apenas profissionais técnicos: buscamos talentos que desenham novas realidades.

Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. **Sobre a oportunidade**

Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados para atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao setor de energia, transformando dados operacionais em modelos estatísticos e ferramentas de apoio à tomada de decisão. O profissional participará da construção de algoritmos de análise de séries temporais, correlação entre variáveis, modelagem estatística e validação de modelos, contribuindo para a evolução de soluções digitais voltadas à confiabilidade e à eficiência operacional de ativos.

* Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes e habilidade para interpretar resultados e comunicar conclusões técnicas.

**Diferenciais**

Claude Code

You will join the Marketing Analytics team, working alongside an experienced Analytics Engineer who will be your closest technical reference. Responsibilities span data modeling, pipeline management, predictive analysis, and the design of machine-readable business context that makes AI agents accurate and trustworthy. This role collaborates closely with teams across the company (including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations) to ensure data-driven insights effectively drive business growth.

This is a Remote – **Brazil** position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in **Brazil**.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

* Build and maintain the marketing data layer, developing pipelines that transform raw marketing sources into dimensional models (following Medallion architecture) and delivering clean, report-ready tables for downstream analytics.
* Maintain and extend BI data models (LookML and/or dbt preferred) enriched with metadata, business context, and structured definitions that make them consumable by AI agents and natural language analytics interfaces.
* Build reusable AI skills, tools, and workflows with guidance from senior engineers, empowering analysts and stakeholders to interact with governed data through natural language interfaces.
* Establish AI quality assurance by running structured test cycles defined with the team to validate AI agent output accuracy, identify regressions, and maintain quality standards as models and data evolve.
* Support the development of statistical and predictive models for marketing funnel metrics, and help maintain and operate the attribution models that measure channel and campaign contribution.
* Ensure data reliability, governance, and documentation through continuous monitoring, data validation, adherence to responsible AI standards, and comprehensive version control in GitHub.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Martech, Global Analytics, Product Development, and Sales Operations—to ensure high-impact data-driven insights drive business growth.
* Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* An analytics or data engineer with solid experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence, or a closely adjacent technical role.
* A technical problem solver with solid in-depth knowledge of **Python** and **SQL**, possessing the ability to write clean, production-grade data pipelines rather than one-off scripts.

* A practitioner with hands-on experience in semantic layer tools (Looker/LookML strongly preferred; Tableau, PowerBI, or similar welcome).
* A curious builder with hands-on experience in applied AI, including LLMs and agentic workflows (designing agent context, AI-assisted pipeline development, or LLM-based production tools).
* A clear, collaborative communicator who enjoys working across both technical and non-technical stakeholders and is fluent in English to collaborate within a globally distributed team.
* An analytical thinker with nice-to-have exposure to AI agent context design (glossaries, structured behavioral rules) and marketing analytics domain knowledge (funnels, attribution, CRM, growth).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in **SQL, Python**, and **hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic workflows** are **mandatory** requirements.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It's important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

jobs.title: Data Architect (Spanish-speaking)
jobs.description:
N-iX is a global software engineering and technology services company, building solutions for clients since 2002. Our teams work across Europe, the Americas, and Asia for Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing businesses in finance, retail, manufacturing, telecom, healthcare, and more.

Our Data & Analytics practice designs and delivers modern data platforms on Snowflake, Databricks, Azure and AWS, from first assessment to production at scale.

  

### **About the role**

We are looking for a Spanish-speaking Data Architect to lead the design of cloud data platforms for our clients. You will own the target architecture end-to-end, work directly with client stakeholders in Spanish, and guide engineering teams through delivery.

The role mixes hands-on technical leadership with consulting: you will shape solutions in pre-sales, run discovery workshops, and stay accountable for architecture quality once the project is live.

  

### **Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end data architectures on Snowflake and/or Databricks, deployed on Azure and/or AWS: ingestion, storage, processing, serving and consumption layers.
* Define lakehouse and data warehouse patterns (medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional models) and choose the right one for each use case.
* Lead migrations from legacy platforms (on-prem DWH, Hadoop, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server) to the cloud, including assessment, roadmap and cutover plan.
* Set standards for data modelling, pipeline design, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and environment strategy.
* Design data governance, security and compliance: access control, data lineage, cataloguing (Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Purview), GDPR and local LATAM privacy laws.
* Optimise platform cost and performance (warehouse sizing, cluster policies, FinOps practices).
* Run discovery workshops and architecture reviews with client business and technical stakeholders, in Spanish and English.
* Support pre-sales: solution design, effort estimates, technical sections of proposals and client presentations.
* Mentor data engineers and review their designs and code; act as the technical point of escalation on the project.
* Prepare data foundations for BI, advanced analytics, ML and GenAI use cases.

### **Requirements**

* 8+ years in data engineering or data platforms, including 3+ years as a Data or Solution Architect.
* Hands-on production experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks (at least one in depth).
* Strong knowledge of Azure and/or AWS data services, for example:
* + Azure: ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Synapse/Fabric, Event Hubs, Purview, Key Vault
  + AWS: S3, Glue, Redshift, Kinesis, Lambda, Lake Formation, IAM
* Expert SQL and solid Python or Scala; experience with Spark.
* Proven experience with data modelling (dimensional, data vault) and lakehouse design.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory or Databricks Workflows.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep or CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data.
* Track record of leading at least one cloud data platform build or migration from design to production.
* Client-facing consulting experience: running workshops, presenting architecture decisions, managing expectations.
* Fluent or native Spanish and at least B2 English, written and spoken.
* Based in an EU or LATAM country with the right to work there.

### **Nice to have**

* Certifications: SnowPro Advanced Architect, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional or AWS Data Analytics/Data Engineer.
* Streaming architectures (Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, Snowpipe Streaming, Delta Live Tables).
* Data mesh, data products and data contracts in practice.
* MLOps and GenAI data foundations (feature stores, vector search, RAG pipelines).
* Domain experience in banking, insurance, retail, telecom or energy.
* Portuguese for Brazil-based clients.

**We offer\*:**

* Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location-specific benefits

* not applicable for freelancers

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
**Why WarriorBabe?**  
  
At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

**Our Mission**

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

**About the role**

WarriorBabe is seeking an Analytics Engineer who can own the reliability and performance of our Supabase/PostgreSQL database and turn business data into clear, actionable insights.

You will maintain data integrations and refresh processes, develop reliable data models, and build useful Metabase dashboards. You will also work directly with leadership and business teams to investigate performance, explain what is driving results, identify opportunities, and recommend measurable actions.

You will help evaluate and improve our data architecture as the business evolves. We welcome recommendations grounded in business needs, reliability, performance, maintainability, and cost.

Success means keeping the data accurate, current, and well documented—and using it to help the business make better decisions.

**Key Responsibilites**

### **Database ownership and performance**

* Manage and improve our Supabase/PostgreSQL reporting database, including tables, views, materialized views, indexes, and SQL queries.
* Diagnose slow queries, blocking, failed refreshes, and resource bottlenecks; use evidence to prioritize improvements.
* Maintain appropriate permissions, review schema changes, and support backup and recovery readiness.
* Plan and validate database changes with clear dependency checks, migration steps, and rollback procedures.
* Evaluate the existing architecture and recommend practical improvements while preserving reporting continuity.

### **Data integrations and n8n**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot production n8n workflows used for data ingestion, synchronization, and reporting.
* Maintain Fivetran connections and custom API integrations, with clear ownership of each source, writer, destination, and downstream dependency.
* Work with CRM, ERM, and other business systems as required.
* Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, duplicate events, partial failures, retries, and safe backfills.
* Monitor actual data delivery and freshness, including failures that may be hidden behind a successful workflow or scheduler status.

### **Data modeling and reporting reliability**

* Develop reusable SQL models with clear record definitions, keys, relationships, and treatment of historical changes.
* Maintain agreed definitions for revenue, clients, conversion, refunds, renewals, retention, and other business metrics.
* Reconcile reporting with its underlying sources and distinguish missing data from a verified zero.
* Prevent duplicate counts and inconsistent totals across dashboards, including differences caused by dates, time zones, attribution, or counting rules.
* Document data lineage, metric definitions, refresh behavior, known limitations, and operating procedures.

### **Metabase dashboards**

* Build and maintain Metabase dashboards, saved questions, filters, and record-level drill-throughs.
* Translate stakeholder questions into reporting that supports a specific business decision.
* Verify saved configuration and the dashboard users actually see, including filters, totals, drill-throughs, and links to operational records.
* Maintain documentation alongside analytical dashboards and preserve dependent reports when making changes.

### **Business analysis and insights**

* Proactively analyze acquisition, sales conversion, revenue, refunds, renewals, retention, and coaching performance.
* Investigate performance changes by relevant cohorts, products, channels, teams, and time periods.
* Distinguish business changes from data-quality problems and clearly separate evidence, hypotheses, and remaining uncertainty.
* Present findings with their business impact, recommended action, and a practical way to measure the result.
* Partner with business owners to evaluate whether actions taken improved outcomes.

### **AI-assisted development and analysis**

* Use AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to accelerate SQL development, data modeling, n8n workflow design, troubleshooting, documentation, and business analysis.
* Use AI to explore patterns, develop hypotheses, review queries and calculations, and identify potential errors or edge cases.
* Validate AI-generated code, calculations, and conclusions against source data and reproducible checks before deploying changes or presenting findings.
* Protect confidential information and protected health information (PHI) when using AI, following company policies and using approved tools.

**Qualifications**

* Hands-on ownership of a production PostgreSQL or Supabase database, including troubleshooting and performance optimization.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregation, query plans, and indexing.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting production n8n workflows. Be prepared to explain a workflow you personally implemented and how it handled failures.
* Experience with API integrations, webhooks, authentication, pagination, rate limits, and reliable synchronization.
* Experience with Metabase or a comparable BI platform, with the ability to work hands-on in Metabase.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate business performance, quantify findings, and recommend actions.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to build, improve, analyze, and check work, with the ability to explain and independently verify the results.
* Ability to explain technical issues and business conclusions clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Experience using Git and maintaining clear technical documentation and controlled production changes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Working knowledge of HIPAA and the privacy and security considerations involved in handling protected health information (PHI) across databases, integrations, and reporting.
* CRM and ERM data structures, relationships, and integrations.
* Fivetran configuration and monitoring.
* Payment, subscription, refund, renewal, or customer-retention reporting.
* Python or JavaScript for scripting and automation.
* Experience with Metabase for understanding and reconciling existing reports.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business teams can understand what key metrics mean and trace results to supporting records.
* Data integrations and reporting refreshes operate within agreed freshness and completeness expectations, with actionable monitoring.
* Database and dashboard improvements have documented validation and preserve dependent reporting.
* Leadership receives useful explanations and recommendations, with follow-up on the actions taken.
* Architecture recommendations include their benefits, tradeoffs, costs, and a practical implementation path.

**Why Join Us**

* Fully remote work with flexibility and Eastern Time overlap.
* Ownership across the database, integrations, reporting, and business analysis.
* Direct collaboration with business leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions.
* An environment that values precision, clear communication, and practical improvements.

jobs.title: Python Developer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

BotCity brings governance to the code AI writes. AI turned asking into code, and every business user is now a developer. The Python they generate runs on corporate workstations outside any pipeline, inventory, or approval flow, and nothing in the enterprise stack was built to see it. BotCity Sentinel governs that code where it runs: a script-level inventory of what executes, where, and by whom, contextual policies that allow, alert, or block, and a remediation loop where the author makes the first fix. Security asks whether code is malicious. Governance asks whether it should run, here, by this person. We built Sentinel to own the second question. Today it's Python. Tomorrow it's every line of code AI writes.

BotCity serves 1,000+ teams in 70+ countries, including customers as Bayer and LG. We raised a $12M Series A led by Four Rivers, with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and founders and investors including Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (SpringSource), and Walter Kortschak (Summit Partners and Firestreak Ventures). G2 named BotCity one of the world's top 25 emerging platforms.

We are a remote company with teams across the US, Canada and LATAM. Small team, large customers, a category forming around us. If you want real ownership over a problem that matters, we should talk.

**Role Overview**

The Python Developer will be responsible for building and maintaining features, libraries, and services of BotCity’s platform, delivering clean, tested, and secure Python code. jobs.title: Hybrid Business Analyst/Database & Power BI Developer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

We are the company that cares – for our staff, for our clients, for our partners and for the quality of the work we do. A dynamic, global company founded in 1995, we bring together more than 2,800 driven, dedicated and passionate individuals. We work on the frontline of medical science, changing lives, and bringing new medicines to those who need them.

 **Job Description**

Only CV's in English will be considered

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Hybrid Database / Power BI Developer (BA/DEV) to join our Process Improvement team. This role combines responsibilities from both the Business Analyst and Developer disciplines. In this hybrid position, the individual is responsible for translating business needs into technical solutions while also designing and developing the underlying data structures and reporting assets. The BA/DEV ensures that business requirements are accurately understood and implemented through well-designed data models, database solutions, and Power BI reporting that deliver meaningful insights and value to stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Stakeholder Management and Requirement Gathering**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand and document business needs, goals, and challenges.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and development tasks.
* Facilitate meetings and discussions with stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify expectations, and collect feedback throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure alignment between business objectives and the technical solutions being implemented.

**2. Solution Design and Technical Planning**

* Design data solutions that support business requirements, including database structures, views, and data models.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of project plans, ensuring technical development aligns with business priorities and timelines.
* Identify opportunities to improve data processes, reporting capabilities, and system efficiency.

**3. Data Development and Implementation**

* Develop and maintain database objects such as tables, views, stored procedures, and data transformations.
* Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights for business users.
* Write and optimize SQL queries to support reporting, data analysis, and system integrations.
* Ensure data models are efficient, scalable, and aligned with reporting requirements.

**4. Product and Development Lifecycle Support**

* Act as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring requirements are clearly understood and implemented.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily standups, and sprint reviews.
* Work closely with development teams to clarify requirements, refine tasks, and ensure deliverables meet business needs.

**5. Testing and Validation**

* Support testing activities by validating that solutions meet business requirements and data accuracy standards.
* Assist in identifying both positive and negative test scenarios aligned with business processes.
* Provide business and technical context during testing to ensure real-world scenarios are properly evaluated.
* Help determine whether issues identified during testing represent defects or expected behavior based on defined business logic.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by coordinating with stakeholders and incorporating feedback into solution improvements.

**6. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are delivered accurately and efficiently.

jobs.title: Software Developer I
BI Analyst - Fintech
jobs.description:
**Sobre Retorna**
-----------------

Somos una fintech especializada en remesas y pagos transfronterizos, 100% remota, con presencia en LATAM y Europa. A través de nuestros envíos de dinero, nuestra wallet en USDT y nuestras soluciones B2B, trabajamos para que mover dinero entre fronteras sea simple, rápido y humano.

**Tu rol como BI Analyst**
--------------------------

Buscamos un/a BI Analyst que se una a nuestro equipo de Data para ayudarnos a transformar la forma en que toda la compañía consume y usa la información. Hoy estamos mejorando y construyendo esa base, y queremos a alguien que no solo entregue reportes, sino que convierta los datos en decisiones.

No es un rol de “hacer dashboards a pedido”. Buscamos a alguien que entienda el negocio fintech, que sepa hacer las preguntas correctas y que tenga conversaciones de impacto y alto valor con stakeholders de distintas áreas, desde Producto y Operaciones hasta Finanzas y Negocio.

**Cómo aportarás al equipo**
----------------------------

* Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y reportes que respondan a preguntas reales del negocio.
* Entender las necesidades de cada stakeholder y traducirlas en métricas, KPIs y análisis accionables.
* Liderar conversaciones con los equipos para presentar hallazgos, generar recomendaciones e influir en la toma de decisiones.
* Contribuir a definir y estandarizar métricas clave para que toda la compañía hable el mismo idioma con los datos.
* Impulsar el autoservicio de datos, ayudando a que más equipos puedan consumir información de forma autónoma y confiable.
* Colaborar con el equipo de Data en la mejora continua de la calidad, la disponibilidad y la gobernanza de la información.

**Requisitos**
--------------

* 3+ años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o en roles similares.
* **Experiencia previa en fintech:** entiendes métricas como transacciones, conversión, retención, fraude o unit economics de productos financieros.
* Dominio de SQL y experiencia con herramientas de visualización (Power BI, Looker, Metabase, Tableau o similares).
* Capacidad para comunicar datos de forma clara a perfiles no técnicos y construir relaciones de confianza con stakeholders.
* Pensamiento analítico y orientación al negocio: te importa el “para qué” detrás de cada número.
* Autonomía para trabajar 100% remoto en un equipo distribuido en múltiples países.
* DBT es un big plus

**Tus primeros meses en Retorna**
---------------------------------

Durante tus primeros meses te familiarizarás con nuestra arquitectura de datos y comenzarás a construir modelos de reportes para las operaciones. Habrás optimizado tableros existentes y colaborado directamente con el equipo de negocio en el análisis de las transacciones de nuestros usuarios.

**Beneficios**
--------------

* 100% remoto, trabaja desde donde estés.
* Días libres ilimitados, porque confiamos en la autonomía y la responsabilidad de nuestro equipo
* Impacto directo en cómo una fintech en crecimiento toma sus decisiones.
* Cultura people-first, con foco en resultados y flexibilidad.

¿Te imaginas ser la persona que ayuda a toda una compañía a decidir mejor con sus datos? Si te motiva construir desde cero cómo se consume la información y tener un rol con voz real frente a los equipos, este es tu momento.

Postula ahora y cuéntanos qué conversación con datos cambió una decisión importante en tu trabajo.

Você atuará em uma empresa do segmento de **Mobilidade Elétrica e Tecnologia**, que desenvolve soluções digitais para conectar motoristas, operadores de eletropostos e diferentes redes de recarga de veículos elétricos.

A plataforma integra aplicativos de recarga, gestão de estações e interoperabilidade entre redes, permitindo localizar carregadores, consultar disponibilidade em tempo real e realizar pagamentos.

Em um mercado em expansão, o desafio é desenvolver soluções confiáveis, escaláveis e eficientes para transformar a experiência de mobilidade elétrica.

**Seu papel nessa jornada**

Nesta oportunidade, você será **contratado(a) diretamente pelo cliente**, uma empresa do segmento de Mobilidade Elétrica e Tecnologia, e fará parte de um time de engenharia de software que está evoluindo uma plataforma digital de alto impacto.

Buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto ao negócio, colaborar com um time técnico e contribuir para a evolução contínua de produtos que transformam a experiência de mobilidade elétrica.

jobs.description:
**Backend Developer (Java) — Bucharest**

**Location:** Bucharest (on-site) · **Team:** Product Engineering · **Reports to:** Head of Technology · **Contract:** permanent employment contract, full-time

**About EC Markets and the role**

EC Markets is an FCA-regulated FX and CFD brokerage. Our engineering team builds and runs our investing and trading app: a React Native / Expo app on iOS, Android and web, backed by a Java Spring Boot API on AWS that connects trading, custody, identity verification, payments and market-data platforms.

We are looking for a Backend Developer to build and strengthen the Java Spring Boot API at the centre of our platform. It connects every platform we rely on, from trading and custody to identity verification and payments, so correctness, security and reliability matter as much as delivery speed.

**What you will be doing**

**Core API & integrations**

* Design, build and maintain features in our Spring Boot services and shared libraries.
* Build and strengthen integrations with trading, custody, identity verification, payments, CRM and notification platforms.
* Make sure money movements (deposits, withdrawals and transfers) are correct, auditable and reconcilable, in line with client money requirements.

**Reliability, security & performance**

* Own PostgreSQL schema design, migrations and query performance for your features.
* Instrument services with logging, metrics and tracing, and take part in the engineering support rota.
* Apply secure-by-default practice: authentication, secrets management and least-privilege access.
* Support load testing and remove performance bottlenecks.

**Delivery**

* Work in Scrum sprints and take work through code review, testing environments and production release.
* Use AI coding tools productively, and own every AI-assisted change: review it, test it and be able to explain it in your pull request.

**What you will bring (non-negotiable)**

* At least 4 years of back-end development in Java (17 or later) with Spring Boot in production.
* REST API design and integration patterns: webhooks, retries, idempotency and asynchronous processing.
* Strong SQL and PostgreSQL, including transactions and schema migrations (Flyway, Liquibase or similar).
* Automated testing with JUnit and integration tests.
* Working knowledge of AWS.
* Experience building systems where data correctness is critical, such as payments, ledgers or financial transactions.
* Git-based workflow with pull-request reviews and CI/CD.
* Confident, practical use of AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgement over their output.
* Professional English for daily work with colleagues across the Group.

**Nice to have**

* Brokerage, trading, payments or wider fintech experience; familiarity with FCA client money rules.
* Infrastructure as code (AWS CDK or Terraform).
* Caching, message queues and event-driven design.
* CRM integration experience.
* js.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 4–7 years of hands-on back-end engineering experience.

**Compensation & benefits**

* **Base salary:** 151,800 RON – 228,000 RON gross per year (12,650 RON – 19,000 RON gross per month), before employee tax and social-security contributions.
* **Annual bonus:** eligible for the Group bonus scheme
* **Pension & social security:** employer contributions in line with statutory requirements.
* **Health:** supplementary health insurance.
* **Annual leave:** 20 working days plus public holidays.
* **Equipment & learning:** company-provided hardware; annual learning and certification budget (incl. cloud and Java certifications).
* **Travel:** occasional travel to other Group offices, paid for by the company.

Where a candidate sits within the band is determined by assessed experience against the role criteria, depth in the required stack (Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS) and relevant financial-services exposure. The same criteria apply to any later pay progression.

**How we hire**

Our recruitment process is aligned with Directive (EU) 2023/970 on pay transparency and equal pay:

* **Transparent pay from the start.** The salary band, bonus and benefits above apply from the first conversation. We will not offer below the published band on the basis of a candidate’s current or previous pay.
* **No salary-history questions.** We will not ask about your current or previous salary at any stage, and our application form does not collect it.
* **Gender-neutral process.** The job title and this description are gender-neutral, and we welcome applications from candidates of all genders and backgrounds. Interview panels are balanced wherever practicable.
* **Objective, written criteria.** Shortlisting, interview scoring and the final offer within the band are made against pre-defined, written criteria, scored independently by each interviewer. The same criteria apply to later pay progression and are available on request.
* **Your rights once hired.** You may discuss your own pay to exercise your right to equal pay, and you may request, in writing, information on your individual pay level and on average pay levels by sex for workers doing the same work or work of equal value, in line with applicable law.

**Process at a glance:** CV screen Talent Acquisition conversation (30 min, incl. salary band) first technical interview with two engineers (60 min) second round: a practical exercise on a realistic task, including AI-assisted coding (2 hours) offer. Typical end-to-end timeline: 3–4 weeks. Reasonable adjustments are available at any stage; just let us know.

**Equal opportunities and how to apply**

EC Markets is an equal-opportunities employer. We make hiring decisions on the basis of skills, experience and demonstrated potential, and do not discriminate on the grounds of sex, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, disability, marital or civil-partnership status, pregnancy or parental status, or trade-union membership.

Please do **not** include your current or previous salary: we will not use it in our decision and are not permitted to ask for it. Any personal data you share will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice and the GDPR.

Questions about the role, the salary band or reasonable adjustments are welcome at any stage; just ask the Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior (IA)
jobs.description:
### **Resumo da vaga:**

Buscamos um(a) **Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior**, com sólida experiência em engenharia de software e desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em **Inteligência Artificial Generativa (GenAI)**, para atuar em projetos estratégicos de transformação digital e inovação tecnológica em uma grande companhia multinacional do segmento de seguros.

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações inteligentes, agentes de IA e soluções de automação, utilizando Python, modelos de linguagem (LLMs) e arquiteturas agênticas, com foco em **Agent Harness, Agent Loop, orquestração de agentes e integração com sistemas corporativos**.

A posição exige perfil hands-on, autonomia técnica e capacidade de desenvolver soluções robustas, escaláveis, seguras e preparadas para ambientes corporativos de alta criticidade.

### **Responsabilidades e atribuições:**

* Desenvolver, implementar e sustentar aplicações e serviços utilizando Python, com foco em soluções de Inteligência Artificial e IA Generativa.
* Projetar e implementar agentes inteligentes baseados em LLMs, incluindo fluxos de raciocínio, execução de ferramentas e integração com APIs e sistemas corporativos.
* Construir e evoluir arquiteturas de **Agent Harness**, estruturando mecanismos de orquestração, gerenciamento de contexto, utilização de ferramentas, observabilidade e controles de execução.
* Implementar **Agent Loops**, desenvolvendo ciclos de execução, avaliação, tomada de decisão, tratamento de erros e critérios de finalização para agentes autônomos.
* Desenvolver soluções utilizando técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings, busca semântica e bancos de dados vetoriais.
* Criar e integrar APIs REST, microsserviços e componentes backend para disponibilização de capacidades de IA.
* Implementar mecanismos de segurança, rastreabilidade, controle de acesso e proteção de dados no consumo de modelos de IA.
* Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software, testes automatizados, versionamento, documentação e integração contínua.
* Monitorar e otimizar o desempenho das soluções, considerando latência, consumo de tokens, custos operacionais, escalabilidade e qualidade das respostas.
* Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de arquitetura, engenharia de dados, segurança da informação, infraestrutura e áreas de negócio.

### **Requisitos e qualificações:**

* Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend utilizando **Python**, com domínio de programação orientada a objetos, programação assíncrona e boas práticas de arquitetura.
* Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de soluções com **IA Generativa e Large Language Models (LLMs)**.

jobs.title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior — Foco em Governança, Catálogo & FinOps Operacional (GCP)
jobs.description:
**Estamos buscando uma pessoa que ouse protagonizar com a gente.**

**Responsabilidades e atribuições:**

* **Governança Ativa e Catalogação:** Implementar e evoluir a governança de dados no GCP utilizando Dataplex (Dataplex Catalog / Aspect Types, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Profiling), criando pipelines automatizados de coleta e enriquecimento de metadados — incluindo a propagação automática de descrições e tags a partir dos arquivos .sqlx/.yaml do Dataform/dbt via IA (Antigravity/LLMs) e o mapeamento automatizado de dashboards e fontes do Looker Studio combinando Looker Studio API, Cloud Audit Logs (BigQueryAuditMetadata) e INFORMATION\_SCHEMA.JOBS.
* **FinOps Operacional no BigQuery:** Monitorar continuamente o ambiente via INFORMATION\_SCHEMA (jobs, storage, reservations, tabelas órfãs), implementando políticas automatizadas de rotulagem (job\_labels e table\_labels) para atribuição granular por centro de custo/tribo, criando alertas de anomalia de custo, quotas customizadas por projeto/usuário (maximum\_bytes\_billed), automatizando o expurgo/arquivamento de tabelas temporárias ou não consultadas (Zombie Tables) e atuando na otimização contínua de queries e armazenamento (Physical vs. Logical bytes).
* **Segurança e Privacidade (By Design):** Definir e automatizar políticas de segurança de dados no BigQuery: controle de acesso baseado em tags (Policy Tags para segurança em nível de coluna - CLS), segurança em nível de linha (RLS) e mascaramento dinâmico de dados (PII/LGPD), integrando varreduras automatizadas com Sensitive Data Protection (Cloud DLP) para descoberta e classificação automática de colunas sensíveis recém-ingeridas via código (Terraform/Python).
* **Contratos de Dados:** Definir a especificação técnica e o schema de Data Contracts (YAML/JSON Schema), o catálogo de contratos e as regras de evolução de schema (Schema Evolution) entre produtores e consumidores de dados, garantindo que as regras sejam acopladas às esteiras de CI/CD e que alterações em sistemas de origem não quebrem o Data Lake de forma silenciosa.

**Requisitos e qualificações:**

* Experiência avançada em Google Cloud Dataplex (incluindo a nova arquitetura de Aspect Types e Entry Groups do Dataplex Catalog em evolução ao Data Catalog clássico), Cloud IAM, Policy Tags e governança de dados em larga escala no BigQuery.
* Domínio profundo das views do INFORMATION\_SCHEMA do BigQuery (JOBS\_BY\_ORGANIZATION, TABLE\_STORAGE\_BY\_ORGANIZATION, RESERVATION\_CHANGES, STREAMING\_TIMELINE), exportação de Cloud Billing Detailed Usage Cost, Cloud Audit Logs e APIs do ecossistema GCP (incluindo Looker Studio API) para construção de soluções automatizadas de observabilidade, inventário e FinOps.
* Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e SQL para automação de políticas de governança, scripts de auditoria e pipelines de metadados.
* Conhecimento prático da arquitetura de precificação do BigQuery (On-Demand vs. Editions/Slots, Storage Logical vs. Physical, Time Travel costs), técnicas comprovadas de redução de custos e entendimento do impacto de performance/cache ao aplicar Row-Level Security (RLS) e Dynamic Data Masking sobre tabelas particionadas e clusterizadas.

**Desejável**:

* Experiência prática com *Sensitive Data Protection (Cloud DLP)* no GCP para classificação automática de dados pessoais (LGPD).
* Certificação *FinOps Certified Practitioner* ou *Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security / Data Engineer*.
* Experiência com padrões abertos de contratos de dados, como *OpenDataContractStandard (ODCS)* ou *Data Contract Specification*, integrados a catálogos de dados.
* Experiência no uso de LLMs/Agentes para enriquecimento automatizado de dicionários de dados e classificação semântica de tabelas legadas.

**Informações adicionais:**

Por aqui, você também conta com vantagens pensadas para apoiar sua rotina, bem-estar e desenvolvimento:

Apoiando a adoção e distribuição do conhecimento na organização e conectando governança às estratégias de dados e IA e à evolução da cultura de dados.

Esta é uma área transversal e multidisciplinar, com interface com diferentes times técnicos de dados e áreas de negócio usuárias de dados e IA, e com oportunidade de contribuir na consolidação de rotinas, documentação e comunicação que aumentem a autonomia das áreas clientes.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho **remoto/home office.**

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

* Executar as iniciativas do programa de governança de dados e IA de ponta a ponta, definindo políticas, papéis (Data Owners/Stewards), padrões, utilizando frameworks de governança ao longo do ciclo de vida do dado.
* Atuar como referência técnica, orientando analistas juniores/plenos e Analytics Engineers na execução do escopo de governança.
* Liderar o catálogo corporativo (Unity Catalog / OpenMetadata): metadados, classificação, linhagem e glossário, garantindo a documentação e adoção pelas áreas usuárias de dados.
* Desenhar e implementar RBAC e ciclo de vida de acessos, padronizando grupos em conjunto com Engenharia de Dados e Gestão de Identidade e Acesso.
* Estabelecer frameworks de qualidade com SLAs, observabilidade e resposta a incidentes para datasets críticos.
* Implantar e operar o processo de gestão de custos do sandbox analítico (ambiente de experimentação para áreas de negócio), estabelecendo modelo de showback e políticas de uso em parceria com as áreas técnicas.
* Liderar frentes regulatórias e de privacidade (BACEN, LGPD), apoiando auditorias e construindo dicionário de dados, linhagem e controles de qualidade dos dados regulatórios junto às áreas parceiras.
* Definir padrões de governança de IA preditiva (inventário, model cards, monitoramento) e IA Generativa (inventário, uso responsável), em parceria com as áreas técnicas e Seg. Info.
* Estabelecer indicadores e dashboards de governança (KPIs de plataforma, FinOps e adoção) para suporte à decisão da liderança.
* Impulsionar data literacy e o modelo de self-service BI seguro em parceria com Pessoas e squads de Dados.

  
**Requisitos e qualificações**  

* Experiência comprovada em **governança de dados e IA** (políticas, processos, padrões, gestão de metadados e catalogação).

jobs.title: Technical Lead -Fullstack
jobs.description:
**J****ob Overview**

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead who still loves writing code. You'll build features across our React/Next.js front ends and our Django, PHP and Magento back ends. You'll review your team's code and keep the work moving every day.

This is a player-coach role. Expect roughly half your time on hands-on development and half on reviews, planning and leading a team of 8–12 engineers. You'll work closely with Product, QA and DevOps to turn ideas into reliable features that ship on time.

**What you'll do**

**Build features (hands-on)**

Design, build and ship features end to end, from React/Next.js screens to Django, PHP or Magento back-end logic and APIs.

Take on the hardest technical problems yourself: performance, integrations, tricky bugs.

Write clean, tested, maintainable code that sets the standard for the team.

**Review code and raise quality**

Review pull requests every day, giving clear and kind feedback that helps people grow.

Set and maintain coding standards, branching rules and a clear definition of done.

Work with QA to keep production bugs low and fix critical issues fast.

**Lead the team and keep work moving**

Break features into clear tasks, estimate effort and plan sprints with the Product Manager.

Support daily stand-ups, spot blockers early and clear them.

Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, reviews and regular one-to-ones.

Keep stakeholders updated on progress, risks and trade-offs in plain language.

**Shape the technical direction**

Make architecture decisions and write them down so everyone understands why.

Improve CI/CD, monitoring and release processes with DevOps.

Help plan upgrades, reduce technical debt and keep the platform secure.

**Must-have skills**

**React and Next.js:** strong, hands-on experience building production apps with hooks, TypeScript, server-side rendering and state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand or similar).

**Back-end (at least one, ideally two):**

**Django / Python:** REST APIs (Django REST Framework), ORM, migrations, background jobs.

**PHP / Magento 2:** custom modules, plugins and observers, checkout and catalogue customisation, performance tuning.

**APIs and databases:** designing REST or GraphQL APIs, and working with MySQL or PostgreSQL, query optimisation and caching (Redis).

**Code quality:** writing and enforcing unit and integration tests, and running thorough, constructive code reviews.

**Engineering practices:** Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and cloud basics (Azure or AWS).

**Security:** OWASP basics, safe handling of secrets and user data, and secure authentication.

**Leadership:** at least 2 years leading or mentoring a team, planning sprints and keeping delivery on track.

**Communication:** clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working with teams across time zones.

**Good to have**

**AI technologies:** hands-on work with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI), RAG pipelines, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone), or frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.

Building AI features into real products, such as chatbots, smart search, recommendations or content generation.

Using AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) responsibly, with clear review practices for the team.

E-commerce experience, especially Magento 2 with a headless Next.js front end.

Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, or infrastructure as code (Terraform).

Performance work such as Core Web Vitals, caching layers, and CDNs like Azure Front Door or Cloudflare.

Experience in Agile/Scrum teams using Jira and Confluence.

**Experience and education**

**7–10 years of software development, with at least 3 years as a tech lead or senior engineer guiding others.**

A proven record of shipping full-stack features to production.

A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Mid Forward Deployed Data & Analytics Specialist
jobs.description:
**Estamos trabalhando na vaga de AI Data & Analytics Specialist para atuar em uma startup de tecnologia de plataforma para criar agentes de IA.**

**Sobre a vaga**  
Estamos buscando profissional para atuação em projetos de inteligência artificial e dados para clientes enterprise como AI Data & Analytics Specialist, com foco em visualização de dados.

Nessa posição, você atuará diretamente com os clientes para entender necessidades de negócio, mapear requisitos e transformar demandas em soluções de dados e visualização de informações. O objetivo é utilizar a plataforma de criação de agentes da empresa e suas capacidades de IA para construir soluções que ajudem as empresas a interpretar informações e tomar decisões com mais clareza.

Você acompanhará os projetos desde o levantamento inicial das necessidades até a configuração da solução, a articulação com os times técnicos e a apresentação dos resultados aos clientes.

Buscamos profissionais com perfil analítico, boa comunicação e conhecimentos em dados, BI e visualização. Não é necessário dominar todas as tecnologias de engenharia de dados, mas é importante possuir uma base consistente em analytics e capacidade de compreender desafios técnicos e de negócio.

A posição é indicada para profissionais que desejam combinar conhecimentos de dados, relacionamento com clientes e inteligência artificial em projetos corporativos de diferentes segmentos.

**Principais atividades**

* Conduzir reuniões com clientes para compreender necessidades, desafios e objetivos relacionados a dados e analytics.
* Realizar o levantamento e o detalhamento de requisitos, transformando necessidades de negócio em escopos e especificações de solução.
* Desenvolver e configurar soluções de visualização de dados e dashboards, conforme as necessidades identificadas.
* Utilizar recursos da plataforma para estruturar agentes, fluxos e funcionalidades que apoiem os projetos de analytics.
* Trabalhar com dados e indicadores para construir visualizações relevantes para os objetivos dos clientes.
* Articular demandas com os times internos de desenvolvimento quando houver necessidade de implementações técnicas mais complexas.
* Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas, pendências e evolução dos projetos.
* Apresentar atualizações de status aos clientes, esclarecer dúvidas e alinhar expectativas.
* Coletar feedbacks e propor ajustes nas soluções implementadas.
* Documentar requisitos, escopos, decisões e informações relevantes para a execução dos projetos.
* Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e das soluções entregues.

  
Requisitos:  

* Experiência ou conhecimentos práticos em Data Analytics, Business Intelligence (BI), engenharia de dados ou áreas correlatas.
* Conhecimento de SQL.
* Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização de dados e construção de dashboards, como Power BI.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Test Automation Engineer (Python)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Senior Backend Test Automation Engineer** to strengthen quality, automation, and validation for a containerized edge-to-cloud platform running Python services on Linux devices. You will build reliable automated coverage for security-sensitive, failure-prone, and intermittently connected environments. Apply now to help raise the bar on end-to-end reliability!

**Responsibilities**

* Design an automation strategy that covers the full device-to-cloud lifecycle across critical workflows
* Build automated test suites for unit, integration, system, end-to-end, resilience, security, and upgrade scenarios
* Validate containerized Python applications on Linux edge devices, including capture, processing, packaging, encryption, and upload flows
* Create synthetic datasets and fixtures to exercise malformed, partial, duplicated, out-of-order, and oversized file cases
* Verify data integrity controls, including metadata, checksums, encryption handling, and secure transfer behavior
* Automate authentication and provisioning scenarios, including identity registration, OAuth token flows, and failure conditions
* Test behavior under real-world constraints such as intermittent connectivity, timeouts, retries, resume, backoff, and replay
* Validate idempotency and effectively-once processing expectations across uploads and processing pipelines
* Assess observability via audit logging, structured logs, health checks, metrics, and alerting signals
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD with coverage reporting, quality gates, and promotion checks
* Define testability requirements with engineers such as dependency injection, mockable interfaces, and deterministic boundaries

**Requirements**

* 3+ years in QA/software test engineering with a strong test automation focus
* Proficiency in automated testing with Python (or equivalent) — fixtures, mocking, parametrized tests, integration harnesses, test isolation
* Background in testing containerized apps and Linux services — process lifecycle, config, logs, networking, resource constraints
* Experience testing REST APIs and distributed device-to-cloud systems — auth, retries, timeouts, failure recovery
* Expertise in validating file-processing/sync/upload/gateway workflows where integrity and resumability are critical
* Strong understanding of idempotency, replayability, ordering, eventual consistency, and exactly-once semantics
* Competency in testing OAuth2/JWT auth — token expiration, refresh, revocation, secure credential handling
* Skills in CI/CD and automated quality gates (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar)
* Knowledge of test coverage practices and enforcing meaningful thresholds
* Familiarity with Docker, as well as cloud services, device management, message brokers, object storage, or Kubernetes
* Practical experience with AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or similar)
* Upper-Intermediate English (B2) proficiency for clear collaboration and documentation

**Nice to have**

* Healthcare tech or regulated-industry experience (HIPAA or similar)
* Qualifications in testing edge computing, IoT, gateway, offline-first, or fleet-management platforms
* Familiarity with pytest, Docker Compose, Linux networking, TLS, AWS, Kafka, OAuth2, REST, device provisioning
* Security testing background — threat modeling, pen-test coordination, secrets management, TPM, secure boot, encrypted storage
* Experience validating monitoring, alerting, automated remediation, updates, rollback, and disaster recovery
* Capability to perform hardware-in-the-loop testing, power-loss/network emulation, bandwidth shaping, physical device labs
* Showcase of testing DICOM, medical imaging metadata, or clinical data-transfer workflows
* Experience with DABs or comparable multi-environment deployment automation, as well as Spec-Driven Development

**We offer**

* International projects with top brands
* Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
* Healthcare benefits
* Employee financial programs
* Paid time off and sick leave
* Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
* Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
* Global career opportunities
* Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
* EPAM Employee Groups
* Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

*EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

jobs.title: SEO & AI Search Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About the role**

How people find brands has changed. More and more buying journeys start with a question to ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot or Claude instead of a list of blue links.

As our AIO Specialist, you will make sure our clients' brands, products and content are found, understood, cited and recommended by AI-powered search and answer engines. You will own the strategy end to end: audit how AI engines see a brand today, define what needs to change across content, technical structure and off-site authority, ship those changes with marketing and engineering teams, and measure the impact.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong SEO fundamentals with a curious, experimental mindset about how LLMs retrieve and synthesize information.

### **What you will do**

* Audit AI visibility: map how often and how accurately a brand appears in AI-generated answers for priority prompts, and benchmark it against competitors.
* Build the AIO/GEO strategy: define the prompt and topic universe, identify content and authority gaps, and turn findings into a prioritized roadmap.
* Optimize content for AI retrieval: restructure and create content that answers questions directly, is easy to extract and quote, and builds topical authority (clear structure, FAQs, comparisons, data, original insights).
* Write paste-ready copy (FAQs, definitions, titles) in the client’s approved product language, and get claims cleared with subject-matter experts and compliance reviewers in regulated markets such as life sciences.
* Strengthen technical foundations: work with developers on crawlability for AI crawlers, structured data (schema.org), entity and knowledge graph signals, site performance, and emerging standards such as llms.txt. Make changes directly in no-code builders such as Framer when faster.
* Grow off-site authority: influence the sources AI engines rely on, such as reviews, directories, Wikipedia/Wikidata, forums, partner content and digital PR.
* Plan industry-specific channels such as LinkedIn, software review sites (PeerSpot, G2) and professional communities.
* Measure and report: track AI share of voice, citations, brand mentions, sentiment and AI-referred traffic and conversions; translate results into clear recommendations for client stakeholders.
* Experiment and share knowledge: run tests, follow changes in AI search products, and help shape 99x’s AIO playbook across clients.

  
**Requirements**  

### **Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy or growth, with hands-on technical SEO knowledge.
* Practical experience optimizing brands or content for AI search / answer engines (AIO, GEO, AEO or LLMO) — with results you can show.
* Solid understanding of how LLM-based search works (retrieval, grounding, citations) and how it differs from traditional ranking.
* Experience with structured data, entity optimization and site architecture.
* Comfortable with analytics and data: GA4, Google Search Console, spreadsheets/BI; able to build simple dashboards and define KPIs.
* Experience with SEO platforms (e.g., Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog) and AI visibility tracking tools (e.g., Profound, Peec AI, Otterly, Semrush AI Toolkit, Ahrefs Brand Radar).
* Strong writing and content editing skills in English.
* Advanced English for daily communication with international clients.
* Able to learn a technical B2B domain quickly and write about it accurately for expert readers.
* Agency or consulting experience managing multiple stakeholders.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience in B2B, SaaS or tech companies, or with North American / European markets.
* Experience in life sciences, pharma, healthcare or another regulated industry, or familiarity with medical affairs terms (KOL, DOL, HCP, MSL, IIS, medical education grants).
* Basic HTML, JavaScript rendering knowledge, or scripting (Python) to automate audits and prompt tracking.
* Experience using LLM APIs or building prompt-testing workflows.
* Hands-on experience with Framer, Webflow or similar no-code site builders.
* Background in digital PR, link building or brand reputation management.

  
**Benefits**  

* We provide resources for you to grow and learn on the job, including online courses, mentoring, and the latest gen laptops;

* A fully remote work environment with flexible working hours;
* Bonus for any referrals that we end up hiring.

jobs.title: Líder Técnico - ML/NLP para Busca Semântica em Android
jobs.description:

* O foco principal da posição é ML/NLP aplicado a busca e ranking; o conhecimento de Android é necessário para entender onde o modelo roda, como ele é integrado, validado, entregue no dispositivo e para manutenção do solução.

* Quantificar e reportar ganhos de performance com metodologia reproduzível (A/B, comparação offline/online, testes de significância).
* Pipeline automatizado e fail cases.
* Liderar o desenho e a implementação de um pipeline automatizado de geração e aumento de datasets multilíngues.
* Estruturar o processo de mineração e análise de fail cases: identificar, categorizar e extrair casos de falha e queries de baixa confiança, criando taxonomias de erro reutilizáveis.
* Desenvolver mecanismos de geração de dados sintéticos a partir dos fail cases, ampliando cobertura multilíngue e robustez dos modelos.
* Integração e entrega no Android - Compreender o fluxo ponta a ponta da busca no dispositivo (indexação local, ContentProviders, Services, execução do modelo on-device) para diagnosticar se um problema está nos dados, no modelo ou na camada de integração Android.
* Investigar e solucionar bugs de busca específicos de região, queries com nuances linguísticas e problemas de localização, propondo correções nos dados, no modelo ou nas regras de processamento junto ao time Android.
* Revisar, validar e apoiar a criação de Test Cases (TCs) em português e espanhol para busca, assegurando aderência linguística e cobertura de cenários regionais.
* Garantir que os patches entregues sejam totalmente validados e prontos para deploy no Android, com documentação técnica, release notes e evidências de teste, considerando restrições de latência, memória e bateria do dispositivo.

  
**Requisitos e qualificações**  

* Experiência em Machine Learning aplicado a NLP, sendo pelo menos 2 anos em search, query understanding, ranking/learning-to-rank, recomendação ou autocomplete/sugestão.
* Experiência prévia em liderança técnica ou atuação como referência técnica sênior, conduzindo decisões técnicas e entregas end-to-end com baixa supervisão.
* Domínio de Python e de pelo menos um framework de deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow), além de bibliotecas de NLP.

* Experiência em preparação de datasets para ML: coleta, limpeza, anotação e aumento de dados, incluindo uso de LLMs para geração ou avaliação.
* Vivência com métricas de avaliação de busca e ranking, e com análise sistemática de erros (fail-case analysis)Prática de versionamento de dados e modelos e experiment tracking, garantindo reprodutibilidade dos resultados.
* Entendimento de como aplicações Android funcionam e se comunicam (ciclo de vida, Services, ContentProviders), suficiente para discutir integração com o time Android e também desenvolver e manter soluções.
* Noções de execução de modelos de ML on-device e de suas restrições de latência, memória e bateria.

**Responsibilities**

* Shape, construct, and continuously advance the cloud platform's architecture to meet both present and upcoming business demands
* Take full responsibility for the infrastructure lifecycle from start to finish, covering provisioning, upgrades, decommissioning, drift detection, and routine operational maintenance
* Build out and sustain Infrastructure as Code through Terraform, handling remote state management via HashiCorp Cloud Platform (HCP)

jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Estamos trabalhando na vaga de **Product Manager** para atuar em uma startup de tecnologia de plataforma para criar agentes de IA.

**Sobre a vaga**  
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa para atuar como Product Manager em um dos seus squads estratégicos, responsável pela experiência e interação dos usuários com soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial.

Nessa posição, você será responsável por transformar a estratégia de produto em entregas concretas, trabalhando em parceria com o time de desenvolvimento para acompanhar o roadmap, organizar prioridades e garantir que as funcionalidades sejam implementadas conforme o planejado.

Além da evolução do produto interno, você também atuará na incorporação de novas demandas provenientes de projetos de clientes, avaliando como essas necessidades podem ser integradas à plataforma e gerar valor para diferentes usuários.

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em gestão de produto, conhecimento prático de inteligência artificial e capacidade de transitar entre as necessidades do negócio e as possibilidades técnicas. É uma oportunidade para quem gosta de construir produtos, trabalhar próximo de times de engenharia e contribuir para a evolução de soluções de IA em um ambiente dinâmico.

**Principais atividades**

* Gerenciar o roadmap do produto, acompanhando o planejamento e a execução das entregas previstas para os ciclos de 30, 60 e 90 dias.
* Organizar, priorizar e manter o backlog do produto, garantindo clareza sobre requisitos, objetivos e critérios de entrega.
* Trabalhar em parceria com desenvolvedores e demais integrantes do squad para viabilizar a implementação das funcionalidades.
* Esclarecer dúvidas sobre requisitos e regras de negócio, garantindo que o time técnico compreenda o que precisa ser desenvolvido.
* Acompanhar o andamento das sprints, identificar impedimentos e realizar ajustes de prioridade quando necessário.
* Incorporar demandas provenientes de projetos externos ao backlog, avaliando sua relevância e integração com a estratégia do produto.
* Interagir com stakeholders internos e externos para compreender necessidades, alinhar expectativas e negociar prazos.
* Traduzir demandas de negócio em requisitos funcionais e especificações compreensíveis para o time de desenvolvimento.
* Acompanhar as entregas até sua disponibilização em produção, verificando a aderência ao escopo e aos objetivos definidos.
* Reavaliar prioridades e estruturar novos itens de backlog conforme a evolução do produto, os feedbacks recebidos e as necessidades identificadas.
* Trabalhar em conjunto com a liderança de produto para garantir alinhamento estratégico e evolução contínua da solução.

  
Requisitos:  

* Experiência prévia como Product Manager, Product Owner ou em função equivalente de gestão de produto.
* Experiência ou contato prático com projetos de inteligência artificial, especialmente soluções baseadas em agentes de IA.
* Conhecimento dos conceitos fundamentais de IA e familiaridade com as tendências e novidades desse mercado.
* Capacidade de estruturar e priorizar backlog, definir requisitos e acompanhar roadmaps de produto.
* Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis e rotinas de trabalho com squads de desenvolvimento.
* Noções técnicas de lógica, fluxos e funcionamento de soluções tecnológicas, sem necessidade de atuar como desenvolvedor de software.
* Habilidade para traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos claros para equipes técnicas.
* Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação com diferentes stakeholders.
* Organização, autonomia e capacidade de gerenciar prioridades e acompanhar múltiplas demandas.
* Inglês funcional para compreender comunicações escritas e participar de reuniões com equipes internacionais.

**Diferenciais**

* Experiência com produtos de IA generativa, agentes inteligentes ou automações baseadas em IA.
* Vivência com plataformas SaaS e produtos tecnológicos escaláveis.
* Familiaridade prática com ferramentas de IA, criação de agentes e construção de fluxos automatizados.
