jobs.title: Software Development Engineer .NET/C# - RaaS
jobs.description:
O que você fará:

Avalara is accelerating the modernization and AI-enablement of its compliance platform to support expanding product complexity, global growth, and high transaction volumes.  
  
We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and Bar Raiser within a globally distributed engineering organization. This role exists to deliver reliable full-stack capabilities, modernize distributed systems, strengthen engineering practices, and lead the practical adoption of AI across software delivery workflows.  
  
The successful candidate will directly improve delivery speed, platform resilience, operational excellence, and engineering standards, while contributing to scalable customer-facing capabilities across Avalara’s compliance platform.

This Software Development Engineer will elevate Avalara across three dimensions:

* **For the Business:** Accelerate delivery while reducing operational risk, enabling the platform to scale across products, customers, jurisdictions, and transaction volumes.
* **For the Team:** Raise engineering standards through technical leadership, rigorous code reviews, automated testing, mentorship, and practical AI adoption.
* **For the Customer:** Improve availability, performance, reliability, and product quality, ensuring dependable compliance experiences for customers globally.

This position is also open to people with disabilities (PcD), in accordance with Law No. 8.213/91  
(Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PcD), conforme Lei nº 8.213/91)

**\*\*Once you apply, please submit your CV in EN.\*\***

LI-Remote

Quais serão as suas responsabilidades:

* Architect, build, and maintain scalable, secure backend services and APIs using .NET and C#, as well as modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
* Design and operate resilient distributed systems using REST and GraphQL service contracts, with sound approaches to scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Embed AI-assisted coding, automated test generation, documentation, refactoring, and architectural analysis into daily engineering workflows to measurably improve velocity and quality.
* Contribute to AI-enabled product capabilities that improve automation, data processing, customer efficiency, or operational insight.
* Design for high availability and operational excellence using proactive monitoring, distributed tracing, metrics, logging, and actionable alerting.
* Lead incident investigation and root-cause analysis; implement preventative improvements that reduce recurrence and improve mean time to recovery.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, release quality, and automated test coverage using GitLab CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Lead technical design discussions, evaluate trade-offs, define service contracts, and reduce technical debt in partnership with Product, Architecture, and engineering stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers, provide constructive peer feedback, participate in interview panels, and raise team standards for ownership, quality, and accountability.
* Collaborate effectively with global engineering, product, and business stakeholders in English.

O que precisa possuir para ser bem sucedido:

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Strong English communication skills, written and verbal, for collaboration with globally distributed teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, developing, and operating production-grade enterprise software.
* Strong hands-on experience with .NET and C# building scalable, resilient APIs and microservices.
* Solid experience with React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
* Experience designing and operating distributed systems and RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and production cloud environments.
* Experience configuring and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, such as GitLab CI/CD.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Solid understanding of relational database design, querying, and performance tuning; experience with SQL Server and/or PostgreSQL is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, end-to-end, and contract testing.
* Demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve measurable engineering or business outcomes.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, enterprise-scale, compliance, financial, or other regulated platforms.
* Experience with high-volume transaction processing systems.
* Experience with observability technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki.
* Experience participating in disaster recovery design, operational readiness, or cloud-native resilience exercises.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives.

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
---------------------------

At Avalara, we hire and promote individuals who raise the bar—those who improve the average performance of the team through their presence.  
  
This engineer will:

  

* Hold high standards for ownership, quality, security, and accountability.
* Exercise sound judgment in architectural decisions, balancing delivery speed with long-term resilience.
* Simplify complexity, challenge assumptions respectfully, and ground decisions in data and measurable outcomes.
* Improve the performance of peers through coaching, example, and constructive feedback.
* Leave systems, documentation, processes, and teams stronger than they found them.

  
A Avalara é uma empresa AI-first:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Como cuidaremos de você:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
O que você precisa saber sobre Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Lead Data Analyst, Growth & Experimentation
jobs.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care into the one-stop shop for all home services. Getting there depends on how fast we can test, learn, and scale what works.

**About the Data Team**

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. The experimentation program runs on real rigor, not vibes: pre-registered analysis plans gate every test launch, anytime-valid statistics keep mid-run dashboards honest under continuous viewing, automated daily SRM and attribution health sweeps catch broken tests early, and seasonal power forecasting accounts for a business that swings hard by time of year. The test lifecycle, design through readout, is already AI-driven. Our analysts are stretched across product, so Growth support has stayed part-time and reactive, until now.

**The Role**

You're the first data analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation. Your primary charter is the **experimentation program**: test design, statistical rigor, and readouts across web funnels, SMS/drip, sales-driven tests, and SEO tests built on our own page-clustering tooling. It's a wider surface than most companies run. You also own the **acquisition-to-conversion funnel** those tests move, across paid, organic, and partner channels. What to test and which direction to bet on is the CRO's and Growth PMs' call; you shape it, they decide it.

You're not starting from scratch. Dashboards, tooling, and rigor scaffolding are already shipped and running. Expect the early months to be hands-on and manual: scoping tests, crunching readouts, while you build toward a self-serve layer. If a test readout and a funnel refresh ever compete for your week, the test wins.

**What makes this role different:**

* The CEO personally engages with test design here: real organizational weight, no fight for buy-in.
* You partner directly with the Director of CRO, performance marketing, and Growth PMs, who come to you when a test needs a call.

  
**Requirements**

**What You'll Own**

* **Experimentation rigor:** test design, power and sample-size calls, significance and readout standards. Core of the role: you catch underpowered tests and false positives before they become bad decisions, and you get Growth's tests onto the anytime-valid monitoring the program already runs, so early calls come from a crossed boundary instead of a hopeful trend read.
* **The self-serve experimentation layer:** automated Growth metrics in Lightdash, Python-backed stat-sig tooling, and the AI skills (Claude routines) already handling pre-test power calcs and live-test health checks. You extend these and keep the layer correct as product and tracking evolve.
* **The Growth funnel model:** a trusted, instrumented view of visitor lead customer across every brand and channel, with the CAC, LTV, and conversion-rate cuts Growth needs to prioritize investment.
* **The Growth analytics function model:** by end of Year 1, the standards and playbook that scale this function beyond one person, plus a buy-vs-build recommendation for the experimentation stack (an off-the-shelf stats engine, or extending our own skills and Python). You bring the recommendation; the final call isn't yours alone.

**Problems to Solve**

**Tests that can't answer the question they were run for** Growth wants more experiments, but volume without rigor produces confident, wrong conclusions. Raising the bar without becoming the bottleneck is the job.

**Getting off the manual treadmill** Real tooling already exists: test-design helpers, dashboards, AI skills. Most tests are still hands-on and bespoke. How do you extend that automation so routine cases genuinely self-serve?

**Making the funnel decision-grade** The semantic layer defines the funnel, but instrumentation is uneven across brands and channels, and no one owns the single trusted view. You build it, and you keep it trusted.

**Turning analysis into decisions** The hard part isn't the SQL. It's getting a PM or marketer to change course. Can you deliver insight sharp enough that the room acts, and push back when the data favors the popular but wrong idea?

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* **Rigor is the default.** Power calculations are standard practice, early stops on Growth tests come from the anytime-valid boundary rather than a trend read, and the re-run rate (redone for tracking or attribution problems) is down.
* **Routine tests self-serve.** Metrics and stat-sig are automated in Lightdash, so the team reads standard results without filing a ticket, and your time goes to the tests that need an analyst.
* **A funnel Growth trusts.** The acquisitionconversion funnel is instrumented across every brand and channel; Growth prioritizes off your model, not side spreadsheets.
* **Measurable conversion wins.** Your analysis directly drove specific, quantified lifts in the funnel, and you can name them.

**Who You Are**

**AI-native.** You use AI daily for SQL, dbt, and pressure-testing your analysis, extending the skills already running our experimentation process rather than merely using them. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI or treat your workflow as fixed.

**A partner, not a report-writer.** You don't wait for a ticket. You sit close to Growth and bring the question before anyone asks it. Skip this one if you want a clear queue with no expectation to push back.

**Statistically sharp.** Wrong fit if "we hit significance" ends your analysis instead of starting it. Right fit if you have a point of view on test design (power, significance, novelty and interaction effects, when not to test) and can explain a broken experiment in plain terms.

**Fluent in experiment instrumentation.** You know how Segment events and Flagsmith randomization interact, and catch a tracking problem before a test ships, keeping our re-run rate down. This isn't for you if instrumentation is someone else's job.

**Fluent in the funnel.** You think in CAC, LTV, and channel economics, and know acquisition data's quirks: attribution messiness, seasonality, channel mix. Skip this one if your background is pure product-feature analytics.

**Technically self-sufficient.** Wrong fit if you need clean data handed to you. Expert SQL, enough Python to automate the stat-sig math, and comfort in dbt and Lightdash, building your own models without waiting on data engineering.

**Influences without authority.** PMs and marketers act on what you find because your insight is clear and honest about uncertainty. This isn't for you if you consider the job done once the analysis ships, regardless of outcome.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A ticket queue.** Not the role if you want well-defined asks: no one hands you a backlog of number-pulls, you decide what's worth measuring.
* **The person who decides what to test.** You shape that call and own its rigor, but the roadmap and final direction belong to the CRO and Growth PMs.
* **A product-feature analyst seat.** Existing analysts already own product, pricing, and service delivery; this one lives in Growth: acquisition, conversion, experimentation.
* **A pure platform or dashboard-builder.** You'll automate metrics, stat-sig, and AI skills into a self-serve layer, but that's the means. The job is designing experiments and keeping that automation correct as product and tracking evolve.
* **A people-management role.** This is an individual-contributor seat.

  
**Benefits**

* **Base salary:** $75,000–$100,000 USD annually.
* **The scope is the draw:** First analyst dedicated entirely to Growth and Experimentation, with your fingerprints on how this company decides what works.
* **AI tooling provided:** The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify.
* **Fully remote:** This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours.
* **Flexible PTO:** Measured on outcomes, not hours logged.

jobs.title: Lead Product Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About LawnStarter**

LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and outdoor services, with over $150M in annual bookings and two consecutive years of profitability. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all home services, and we're investing in the next generation of our platform to get there.

**About the Team**

We're a high-leverage team of Product Data Analysts embedded across the business, owning the semantic layer and the metrics everyone trusts. We turn "I have a hunch" into "here's what actually happened," and we're the reason teams across the company can make calls on evidence instead of instinct. This role brings dedicated analytical firepower to the Pro (supply) side of that work.

 **Requirements**

**The Role**

As a Lead Product Data Analyst, you'll directly impact our results through insights and reports. You'll work closely with product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. Alongside the rest of the Analytics team, it's your responsibility to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, whether through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, or training.

You'll work with the autonomy of a Lead: setting your own standards, working independently, and acting as a trusted thought partner rather than an order-taker. That title isn't about managing people, there's no team attached to it. It's about the bar you hold your own analysis to, and the bar you help everyone around you reach.

This role leans toward the Pro (supply) side of our marketplace, though the exact focus flexes with where the business needs the most insight.

**What You'll Own**

* **Modeling & Analysis:** A marketplace is a complex system, with many moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, and optimizations. Analyses range from a simple A/B test to a multivariate model on retention or ETA, backed by advanced SQL and intermediate Python or R.
* **Reporting:** A complex system produces a high number of metrics worth tracking. A dashboard is only as good as our trust that it's correct and current. You'll understand the needs of the teams you work with and help create and maintain the reporting system, keeping it organized and easy to act on.
* **Analytics Engineering:** Occasionally you'll work in the inner layers of the Data Warehouse to provide clean, documented datasets that power our reports and end users. We use dbt for transformation, so SQL is a must.

**Problems to Solve**

**Metrics nobody fully trusts.** Different teams cite different numbers for the same thing, and no one's quite sure which is current. Untangling that and giving the business one number it can stand behind is core to the job.

**Analysis that ships but doesn't move anything.** A technically correct answer that doesn't change a single decision is still a failure. Getting a stakeholder to actually act on what you found is the hard part, not the SQL.

**Data that's hard for anyone but an analyst to touch.** If every question requires filing a ticket and waiting on you, you haven't built a data-driven culture, you've built a bottleneck.

**A system with too many moving parts and not enough signal.** Supply, demand, pricing, and service quality all interact. Teasing out what's actually driving a metric versus what's noise is a real analytical problem, not a formality.

**What Success Looks Like (Year 1)**

* The metrics teams rely on daily are trusted, documented, and current, no one's quietly keeping a shadow spreadsheet because they don't trust the dashboard.
* Routine questions are self-serve: stakeholders find their own answers in existing reports instead of pinging you for a one-off pull.
* You can name specific decisions your analysis changed, not just analyses you delivered.
* The datasets and models you've built in dbt are clean and documented enough that other analysts build on them without redoing your work.

**Who You Are**

**AI-Native:** You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and similar) daily to move faster: drafting and debugging SQL and dbt models, scripting analysis, and shaping reports, and you keep experimenting with new capabilities as they show up. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're skeptical of AI tools or prefer to do everything by hand.

**Learning Mindset:** You take pride in understanding problems deeply and asking the right questions before reaching for an answer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you have a preconceived system of processes and methods and plan on just applying them without first learning all the ways our business is unique.

**Sets the Bar:** As a Lead, you work autonomously, hold your own analysis to a high standard, and raise the bar for the people around you, whether or not they report to you. Product managers and stakeholders should see you as a trusted thought partner, not an order-taker. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you want a title and a team before you're willing to raise everyone else's standards.

**Team Player:** You are ready to work alongside exceptional people, helping them achieve great results. You create an environment where people are excited to work with you daily, with intellectual honesty and trust. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you value being right over reaching the right answer together.

**Business Focus:** You care deeply about understanding business needs and how your analysis connects with our product, customers, and financials. You can envision how metrics drill down from the highest to the lowest level, identifying what needs to be analyzed or reported on at each. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you're happiest doing analysis for its own sake, disconnected from a decision it will drive.

**Bias for Action:** You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems, you actively avoid being a perfectionist or getting tied up in knots. You have a bias for action to make progress, and you enjoy being scrappy, with constraints that enthrall you. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you, by default, like building full solutions from the get-go.

**This Role Is NOT**

* **A ticket queue.** You're not here to pull numbers on demand, you decide what's worth measuring and how to measure it.
* **A dashboard-admin seat.** Maintaining BI tooling is part of the job, not the point of it. The point is the insight the dashboard delivers.
* **A people-management role.** This is an individual-contributor seat. "Lead" describes the bar you hold yourself and others to, not a team you manage.
* **A role that waits for perfectly clean data.** If you need data handed to you pre-cleaned before you can start, this isn't the right seat, you're expected to get your hands into the warehouse.

**Tools of the Trade**

SQL and dbt for transformation and modeling, Python or R for the occasional statistical deep dive, and Lightdash as our primary BI layer for dashboards and self-serve reporting.

 **Benefits**  

* + **Base salary:** $75,000–$100,000 USD annually.
  + **AI tooling provided:** The Claude routines already running pieces of our experimentation process are yours to extend, not a side project you have to justify.
  + **Fully remote:** This is deep-focus analytical work with US-facing partners. We hire the best analyst regardless of city and trust you to manage your environment and overlap hours.
  + **Flexible PTO:** Measured on outcomes, not hours logged.

**VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER:** Please upload your English resume. Applications without it will not be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Localize (https://localizejs.com/) is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our growing product engineering team. As Localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. As a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve Localize's technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. Your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the Localize platform.

You will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. Like every product engineer at Localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager.

This is a hands-on software engineering role as well as an infrastructure ownership role. You will be expected to operate at a senior backend engineering level, contributing production application code and owning complex changes from design through rollout and ongoing operation. You will also contribute across the stack when needed to deliver complete customer-facing solutions, balancing product development with infrastructure, security, and developer experience priorities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee and manage Localize's infrastructure across AWS and Cloudflare.
* Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and background processing workflows. Work hands-on in the Localize application, including the dashboard, public APIs, legacy workers, and BullMQ workers; not only the infrastructure that supports them.
* Own complex product engineering work end to end: clarify requirements, propose pragmatic designs, implement application and infrastructure changes, and validate releases in production. Contribute frontend changes when needed to complete the customer experience.
* Apply sound engineering judgment to data modeling, API contracts, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. Diagnose and resolve application-level performance and reliability issues, including inefficient queries, queue bottlenecks, and search behavior.
* Raise the quality and maintainability of the codebase through automated tests, thoughtful code reviews, and incremental refactoring. Share knowledge and mentor teammates on backend design, debugging, and operationally sound software development.
* Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of Localize's data stores, specifically Redis and MongoDB, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
* Own and improve deployment process and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
* Partner with product engineers to improve the full SDLC, including development environments, CI/CD, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. Treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
* Take a leading role in infrastructure security and SOC 2 Type II compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. Responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
* Help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
* Prioritize infrastructure and SDLC improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. Communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
* Own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as Datadog, Clickhouse, HyperDX, and more
* Identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
* Develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
* Play an active role in Developer Experience enhancement
* Actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

Technologies

*Experience with the specific technologies below is a plus unless listed under Must-Have Skills. Security and compliance, including support for SOC 2 Type II, are core responsibilities of this role—not optional areas of involvement.*

* AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, Cloudfront, EC2, Elasticache, Route 53, VPS
* Platforms: Kubernetes, AWS Beanstalk, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions
* Languages: Terragrunt, OpenTofu, Terraform
* Monitoring: Clickhouse, Datadog, HyperDX, Grafana
* Security & Compliance: SOC2 Type II
* Cloudflare DNS, Workers, Zero Trust (WARP)
* Business Intelligence: Stitch, Metabase, Snowflake
* Application Technology: MongoDB (Atlas + Cloud Manager), Typescript, React

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 5+ years engineering experience. At least 4 years of experience in a Platform Engineer role.
* Expertise in managing and optimizing infrastructure in AWS.
* Redis and MongoDB, including configuration, monitoring, optimization, and management of backups.
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools OpenTofu and Terragrunt
* Experience with manual or automated deployment & release management.
* Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes and tools.
* Hands-on experience securing production infrastructure, including least-privilege access controls, vulnerability remediation, secrets management, and security monitoring.
* Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into repeatable engineering practices, maintain evidence of control operation, and support SOC 2 Type II audit readiness and remediation.
* Experience partnering with product engineers to improve the SDLC and balance feature delivery with reliability, security, and developer productivity.
* A customer-obsessed, business-aligned approach: understand how infrastructure decisions affect customers, prioritize work by impact, and explain technical tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Skills in assessing and optimizing performance of infrastructure and applications for improved performance, reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
* Demonstrated senior-level backend engineering experience: independently designing, shipping, and maintaining production application features and services, beyond infrastructure configuration and scripting.
* Strong hands-on proficiency with Node.js and JavaScript/TypeScript, including API development, asynchronous programming, automated testing, and debugging production systems.
* Experience designing application data models and reliable background jobs, including safe retries, idempotency, and failure recovery. Ability to reason about performance and correctness across application code, databases, and queues.
* Ability to work across backend and frontend boundaries, learn the relevant parts of our application stack, and collaborate with product engineers to deliver complete features. Communicate designs and tradeoffs clearly, give constructive code reviews, and help teammates solve difficult technical problems.
* Proficiency in command line scripting
* Disaster Recovery Planning including data integrity and availability in case of emergencies.
* Experience with APM and logging tools such as DataDog, New Relic, Sentry, or Kibana.

**Nice-to-Have Skills or Experience:**

* Product Engineering languages and frameworks such as Typescript, React, Mongoose, LESS, and more
* Applied LLM engineering:
  + Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar)
  + Strong understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and token management
  + Experience designing or implementing RAG pipelines, embeddings, and vector search
  + Familiarity with emerging LLM infrastructure patterns and protocols (e.g., MCP, tool/function calling, agents)
* Working in a fast-paced environment where you're accountable for your work and you're passionate in working with customers

**Benefits & Perks:**

You'll be joining a close knit and talented team, with plenty of opportunity for professional growth. We offer compensation + benefits that are on par with large companies, while also placing a high value on maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

* Competitive salary
* 401(k) plan + 4% matching
* 100% company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
* Company-paid life insurance and AD&D insurance
* Work anywhere in North America (we are 100% remote)
* New Macbook (or computer of your choice)
* Monthly stipend for home internet costs
* Generous PTO package

**About Localize:**

The Localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. We support organizations like The Bay Area Toll Authority (https://www.bayareatollpaymentplan.org/s/) in translating their payments website, Baptist Health (https://www.baptistjax.com/) in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (https://www.doe.mass.edu/) in offering their content in several languages. To see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from English to another language.

Localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the Google Analytics JavaScript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. The Localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the Localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. Localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

We are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. We offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

**To apply:**

Along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. Previous experience working in a remote position is a must.

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist | AI Platform
jobs.description:
Estamos trabalhando na vaga de Customer Success Specialist para atuar em uma startup de tecnologia de plataforma para criar agentes de IA.

**Sobre a vaga**  
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com excelente comunicação, perfil consultivo e inglês fluente para liderar a jornada de onboarding e acompanhamento dos clientes da plataforma.

Você será responsável por apoiar os clientes desde os primeiros contatos com a solução, garantindo que compreendam como utilizá-la, aproveitem seus recursos e consigam incorporá-la à rotina de trabalho. A atuação será especialmente próxima durante os primeiros 90 dias da jornada, período fundamental para a adoção da plataforma e a construção de um relacionamento sólido.

Essa é uma oportunidade para fazer parte da estruturação da área de Customer Success em uma startup de tecnologia e inteligência artificial, com espaço para propor melhorias, organizar processos e contribuir diretamente para a experiência e a retenção dos clientes, incluindo clientes internacionais.

**Principais atividades**

* Conduzir o onboarding de novos clientes, orientando-os sobre a plataforma, seus recursos e suas possibilidades de utilização.
* Acompanhar de perto a jornada dos clientes, especialmente durante os primeiros 90 dias após a implementação.
* Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento para entender necessidades, esclarecer dúvidas e apoiar a utilização da solução.
* Monitorar a adoção e o engajamento dos clientes com a plataforma, identificando dificuldades e oportunidades de melhoria.
* Identificar riscos de insatisfação, baixa utilização ou cancelamento (churn), atuando preventivamente para melhorar a experiência dos clientes.
* Atuar como ponte entre os clientes e os times internos, levando feedbacks, dúvidas e necessidades para as áreas responsáveis.
* Manter os clientes informados sobre o andamento das iniciativas e ações relacionadas às suas necessidades.
* Traduzir as demandas dos clientes em informações claras para os times internos, contribuindo para a evolução da solução e dos processos.
* Desenvolver um relacionamento próximo e consultivo com clientes brasileiros e internacionais.
* Contribuir para a estruturação dos processos, indicadores e rotinas da área de Customer Success.
* Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a experiência, a adoção da plataforma e a retenção da base de clientes.

  
Requisitos:  

* Experiência com Customer Success, especialmente em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou negócios digitais.
* **Inglês Avançado para conversação, pois atenderá clientes US e BR.**
* Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de adaptar a abordagem a diferentes perfis de clientes.
* Perfil consultivo, com habilidade para compreender necessidades, investigar dificuldades e propor soluções.
* Capacidade de construir relacionamentos de confiança e acompanhar clientes de forma próxima e proativa.
* Organização e habilidade para gerenciar diferentes clientes, demandas e acompanhamentos simultaneamente.
* Proatividade para identificar riscos, antecipar problemas e conduzir ações de melhoria.
* Capacidade analítica para acompanhar a utilização da plataforma, identificar sinais de risco e propor ações para aumentar a adoção.
* Autonomia e adaptabilidade para atuar em um ambiente de startup, no qual processos e indicadores ainda estão em desenvolvimento.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Specialist | Forward Deployed AI
jobs.description:
Estamos em busca de profissionais experientes para atuar como Forward Deployed Integrators (FDIs), conectando as necessidades dos clientes às soluções de inteligência artificial desenvolvidas e disponibilizadas pela empresa.

Essa posição combina atividades de entendimento de négocio, levantamento de requisitos, desenho de soluções e gestão de projetos. Você será responsável por compreender os desafios dos clientes, identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA e estruturar soluções utilizando a plataforma de criação de agentes da empresa.

O trabalho envolve desde o discovery e o mapeamento de necessidades até a configuração de agentes e fluxos, o alinhamento com os times técnicos e o acompanhamento das entregas junto aos clientes.

Você poderá atuar tanto em projetos já em andamento quanto no levantamento de novas demandas, contribuindo para a definição do escopo de soluções e, quando necessário, apoiando a estruturação de propostas técnicas em conjunto com as áreas envolvidas.

Buscamos profissionais com boa base técnica, experiência prática com inteligência artificial e capacidade de conduzir conversas com stakeholders de negócio e tecnologia. Não é necessário ser desenvolvedor de software, mas é fundamental compreender lógica, fluxos, requisitos e possibilidades de implementação de soluções de IA.

É uma oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver problemas complexos, trabalhar próximo dos clientes e acompanhar a construção de soluções tecnológicas do início à entrega.

**Principais atividades**

* Conduzir reuniões de discovery com clientes para compreender problemas, necessidades, processos e oportunidades de aplicação de IA.
* Realizar o levantamento e o detalhamento de requisitos funcionais e técnicos dos projetos.
* Desenhar soluções utilizando a plataforma da empresa, identificando agentes, fluxos e funcionalidades adequados a cada necessidade.
* Configurar e parametrizar agentes de IA e fluxos de trabalho de acordo com os requisitos definidos.
* Traduzir demandas dos clientes em escopos claros, requisitos e planos de execução.
* Avaliar a viabilidade das soluções propostas e identificar quando é necessário envolver o time interno de desenvolvimento.
* Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, Product Owners e demais stakeholders para viabilizar as entregas.
* Acompanhar cronogramas, marcos, pendências e evolução dos projetos, garantindo visibilidade sobre o andamento das iniciativas.
* Apresentar atualizações de status aos clientes, demonstrar soluções e alinhar expectativas durante a execução.
* Gerenciar mudanças de escopo e negociar prioridades e prazos conforme as necessidades dos projetos.
* Apoiar o levantamento de novas demandas e a estruturação de escopos iniciais para propostas comerciais, quando necessário.
* Documentar decisões, requisitos, fluxos e especificações das soluções.
* Acompanhar feedbacks dos clientes e identificar oportunidades de evolução das soluções implementadas.
* Atuar como ponto de conexão entre o cliente e os times internos, garantindo que as necessidades de negócio sejam compreendidas e traduzidas em entregas viáveis.

  
Requisitos:  

* Experiência em Product Ownership, gestão de projetos tecnológicos, implantação de soluções, consultoria técnica ou funções correlatas.
* Experiência prática com inteligência artificial, incluindo criação ou configuração de agentes, automações ou fluxos inteligentes.
* Conhecimento dos conceitos fundamentais de IA generativa e familiaridade com tecnologias e aplicações desse mercado.
* Noções técnicas de lógica, arquitetura de soluções e funcionamento de fluxos de sistemas.
* Capacidade de realizar discovery, levantar requisitos e transformar problemas de negócio em soluções estruturadas.
* Habilidade para configurar e parametrizar soluções utilizando plataformas tecnológicas existentes.
* Capacidade de compreender demandas técnicas e articular soluções com equipes de desenvolvimento.
* Experiência no acompanhamento de projetos, gestão de prazos, alinhamento de expectativas e comunicação de status.
* Excelente comunicação interpessoal, com segurança para conduzir reuniões e interagir com stakeholders de diferentes níveis.
* Perfil consultivo, analítico, organizado e orientado à resolução de problemas.
* Autonomia para conduzir projetos e tomar decisões dentro do escopo de sua atuação.
* Inglês funcional para compreender comunicações escritas e participar de reuniões internas.

Diferenciais

* Experiência com plataformas de agentes de IA, LLMs (Large Language Models) e construção de workflows inteligentes.
* Conhecimento de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e técnicas de integração de modelos de linguagem com fontes de dados.
* Experiência em implantação de soluções tecnológicas em clientes corporativos.
* Vivência em projetos de SaaS, integrações de sistemas ou automação de processos.
* Experiência em consultoria de tecnologia, arquitetura de soluções ou pré-vendas técnicas.
* Conhecimento de APIs, integrações e conceitos de arquitetura de software.
* Experiência em projetos para grandes empresas ou ambientes com processos e requisitos complexos.

jobs.title: Consultor(a) de Governança de IA e Privacidade Pleno/Sênior
jobs.description:
**Principais responsabilidades:**  
  
1.1 Estruturação do programa

* Estruturar o programa de governança de IA do cliente: papéis, critérios de classificação de risco, alçadas e indicadores, em conjunto com o comitê de governança e riscos e o centro de excelência de IA.
* Orientar na construção dos questionários de inventário de sistemas de IA e de avaliação de impacto algorítmico, com base na LGPD, no EU AI Act, no PL 2338/2023, na ISO/IEC 42001 e no NIST AI RMF.
* Estruturar e transformar requisito regulatório em questionário, critério de risco, fluxo e indicador.
* Desenhar o fluxo de submissão e aprovação de novos casos de uso e modelos de IA, com critérios de decisão e trilha de auditoria.
* Apoiar a elaboração e a revisão de políticas e diretrizes de uso de IA, quando contratadas.

1.2 Operação e acompanhamento

* Disparar as avaliações às áreas responsáveis, acompanhar prazos e pendências, consolidar as respostas e registrar riscos e medidas de mitigação na plataforma.
* Analisar as respostas e emitir recomendações técnicas sobre risco e mitigação, para decisão do cliente e do comitê.
* Manter o inventário de sistemas de IA atualizado e a classificação de risco revisada a cada mudança relevante.
* Orientar o time técnico na parametrização do módulo OneTrust AI Governance: templates, formulários, catálogos de risco e fluxos.
* Produzir os painéis de risco algorítmico e os relatórios periódicos para o comitê e para a alta administração.

1.3 Capacitação, regulação e interfaces

* Conduzir capacitações das áreas sobre uso responsável de IA e sobre o fluxo de submissão de casos de uso.
* Acompanhar a evolução regulatória de IA no Brasil e no exterior e propor ajustes no programa e nos questionários.
* Manter o DPO da conta informado sobre andamento, riscos e interfaces com o programa de privacidade.
* Atuar em outros projetos de governança de IA e privacidade da carteira, incluindo seções de IA em avaliações de impacto de privacidade (RIPD e DPIA).
* Formalizar status, decisões e pendências por e-mail e manter o quadro de gestão atualizado.
* Conduzir workshops e reuniões com comitês, áreas de negócio e tecnologia, e boa escrita para relatórios e formalizações.

  
Requisitos:

**Obrigatórios**:

Graduação completa em Direito. Outras formações (Administração, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados) são aceitas com pós-graduação ou especialização em direito digital, proteção de dados ou regulação de tecnologia.  

Experiência em privacidade, proteção de dados, compliance ou regulação, com atuação consultiva, em escritório de privacidade ou em área interna de governança.  
Governança de IA na prática: participação em ao menos uma iniciativa real, ainda que parcial: inventário de sistemas de IA, avaliação de impacto algorítmico, política de uso de IA ou estruturação de comitê.  
Regulação: domínio do EU AI Act (classificação por nível de risco e obrigações por papel), conhecimento do PL 2338/2023 e da interface entre IA e LGPD (bases legais, decisões automatizadas, direito de revisão e RIPD).  
Frameworks: conhecimento aplicado de ao menos um entre ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894 e NIST AI RMF.  
Letramento técnico: entendimento dos tipos de sistema (IA generativa, modelos preditivos, agentes), do ciclo de vida de um modelo e de temas como dados de treino, viés, explicabilidade e supervisão humana.  
* Certificação, ao menos uma concluida:
  + AIGP (Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional) - IAPP
  + ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor - PECB, BSI ou certificadora equivalente
  + AI Compliance Professional (AICP) - EXIN
  + AAIA (Advanced in AI Audit) - ISACA
  + BCS Artificial Intelligence Foundation ou Essentials - EXIN

**Desejáveis:**

* Experiência com plataformas de privacidade e governança, em especial OneTrust (módulo AI Governance), Privacy Tools ou Securiti.ai.
* Programa de governança de IA entregue de ponta a ponta.
* Experiência no setor de educação ou com sistemas de IA que tratam dados de crianças e adolescentes.
* Vivência com governança de ferramentas corporativas de IA generativa, como Microsoft Copilot e Google Gemini, incluindo descoberta de agentes.
* Vivência em consultoria multiclientes.
* Conhecimento do ECA Digital (Lei nº 15.211/2025).
* Experiência em consultoria, atendendo mais de um cliente ao mesmo tempo.
* Idiomas: Inglês avançado e Espanhol intermediário.
* Certificações:
  + Privacy and Data Protection Foundation (PDPF), Practitioner (PDPP) ou Certified Data Protection Officer - EXIN.
  + CIPP/E, CIPM ou CIPT - IAPP.
  + ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor - PECB ou certificadora equivalente.
  + Certificação oficial OneTrust - OneTrust.

  
Benefícios  

* Vale Refeição
* Wellhub
* Plano de Saúde Bradesco
* Equipamento fornecido pelo parceiro

jobs.title: Senior Developer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Be yourself, be your best!**

Combinamos nossa experiência global em indústrias-chave e as últimas tecnologias para ajudar empresas em rápido crescimento e estabelecidas a transformar e acelerar seus modelos de negócios, desenvolver soluções digitais inovadoras, escalar capacidades tecnológicas e sustentar seu crescimento. Estamos procurando um **Senior Developer Support Engineer** com forte experiência em Cloud e engenharia de sistemas para fazer parte de uma equipe de Sustaining Engineering. A função envolve troubleshooting, bug-fixing e gestão de escalonamentos de suporte. O profissional trabalhará próximo da equipe de engenharia do cliente e dos usuários finais para resolver problemas técnicos. O candidato ideal tem experiência em engenharia de sistemas em infraestrutura de nuvem, como GCP, Kubernetes e pipelines de CI/CD, além de excelentes habilidades de comunicação.

**O que você fará nessa função:**

* Prestar suporte técnico aos clientes por meio de tickets e chamadas ao vivo, solucionando problemas relacionados à tecnologia GraphQL em uma ampla variedade de ambientes.
* Investigar, reproduzir e corrigir bugs na base de código.
* Gerenciar tickets via Jira Service Management, garantindo respostas e resoluções dentro dos SLAs.
* Colaborar com as equipes de plataforma na solução de problemas envolvendo APIs de cliente e ambientes de backend.
* Realizar deep-dive troubleshooting em clusters Kubernetes e ambientes AWS e GCP para identificar e corrigir configurações incorretas e gargalos de desempenho.
* Participar do processo de triagem e escalonamento, incluindo escalonamentos para a equipe de Engenharia quando necessário.
* Participar da gestão de incidentes com impacto nos clientes. Isso inclui coordenar a resposta, comunicar o status a clientes e stakeholders internos e contribuir com post-mortems e ações de follow-up.
* Apoiar o treinamento e o onboarding de engenheiros de suporte juniores à medida que a equipe cresce.

**Está posição é adequada para você se você:**

* Ampla experiência com plataformas de nuvem, preferencialmente GCP e/ou AWS.
* Forte experiência em Kubernetes, incluindo implantação, gerenciamento e troubleshooting em ambientes de larga escala.
* Experiência avançada com Terraform ou ferramentas semelhantes para provisionamento e automação de infraestrutura.
* Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub) e boas práticas de DevOps.
* Familiaridade com a tecnologia GraphQL, de preferência incluindo conceitos de GraphQL Federation.
* Capacidade comprovada de escrever, ler e depurar código em Rust ou Java.
* Ampla experiência com uma ou mais ferramentas de APM (Datadog, Grafana, New Relic, Splunk etc.) para monitoramento de desempenho e depuração.
* Capacidade de simular ambientes complexos de clientes para depuração e validação, por exemplo configurações de federação personalizadas, plugins e subgraph mocks.
* Mais de 5 anos em funções de suporte técnico ou engenharia de sistemas.
* Experiência em ambientes de suporte de alta disponibilidade (24/7), incluindo escalas de plantão (on-call) e PagerDuty ou ferramentas semelhantes.
* Forte conhecimento de sistemas de tickets (por exemplo, JSM e Salesforce) e de fluxos de trabalho de suporte.
* Disponibilidade para plantão (on-call) em situações de emergência. Eventualmente pode haver cobertura em fins de semana.

**Seria ótimo se você tiver:**

* Experiência prática com frameworks GraphQL em produção, especialmente arquiteturas federadas.
* Familiaridade com engenharia de sistemas e práticas de SRE.
* Experiência com Node (escrever, ler e depurar código).
* Experiência em equipes distribuídas, em ambiente internacional e com múltiplos fusos horários.

**Onde você estará baseado:**

* Brasil - Remoto. Trabalho remoto com horário flexível para atender clientes globais, principalmente nos EUA (fusos MT/PT).

**Beneficios de ser e-Corean!**

Entre outros benefícios para tornar sua e-Core experience mais enriquecedora

Na e-Core, recrutamos com intencionalidade para refletir nossa cultura, valorizando a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Acreditamos que gênero, idade, etnia, raça, religião, orientação sexual e outros marcadores de identidades são ativos que enriquecem nosso time, sem barreiras para talentos brilharem. -------------------------------------------

**Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Product Owner na área de customização do ERP Lyceum dentro da nossa Fábrica de Software.**

**Há mais de 30 anos, desenvolvemos soluções que ajudam organizações públicas e privadas que são referência no Brasil a atingir seus objetivos melhorando a performance da gestão. Possuímos um time de especialistas em educação, gestão de pessoas, saúde e tecnologia para garantir a transformação digital do seu negócio.**

**Se você tem interesse em atuar com as tecnologias mais avançadas em uma empresa que preza por:**

**Ambiente digital e descontraído**

***Equipe diversificada, multicultural e cheia de oportunidades***

**Autonomia no trabalho**

***Reconhecemos o seu talento. Tenha liberdade para propor soluções***

**Desenvolvimento**

***Valorizamos sua dedicação e queremos que você evolua com a gente***

**Fazer a diferença**

***Cresça conosco e mude a vida de milhões de pessoas***

  

Inscreva-se!

 **Responsabilidades e atribuições**  

* Organizar e priorizar o backlog de customizações do produto.
* Levantar requisitos direto com os clientes e transformar cada pedido em épicos, histórias e critérios de aceite prontos para desenvolvimento.
* Definir com a engenharia a melhor forma de desenvolver cada customização sobre o produto que já existe, avaliando o impacto em regras, módulos e integrações.
* Acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos projetos: levantamento, especificação, desenvolvimento, homologação e entrega.
* Fazer engenharia reversa dos produtos atuais, lendo o código para entender as regras e documentá-las para o time.
* Usar IA em todo o fluxo: escrita de histórias, gestão de cards, documentação e análise de impacto.
* Dar visibilidade de prazos, riscos e entregas para clientes e liderança, junto com a Scrum Master e a coordenação técnica.

  
  
  
**Requisitos e qualificações**

**Esperamos que você tenha**

  

* Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Design, Educação ou áreas correlatas.
* Experiência como Product Owner, Analista de Requisitos ou Analista de Negócios, atuando com produtos B2B e B2C.
* Vivência em fábrica de software ou em projetos de customização e evolução de produtos já existentes.
* Experiência com levantamento de requisitos direto com o cliente.
* Domínio da escrita de épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite.
* Facilidade para ler código e consultar banco de dados a fim de entender e documentar regras de negócio.
* Uso de IA generativa no dia a dia de trabalho.
* Experiência em priorizar backlog com demandas de vários clientes.

* **E será um diferencial se você tiver**

jobs.title: Senior React Native Engineer (Expo & TypeScript)
jobs.description:
**Join Our Team**

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced **Senior React Native Engineer** to help build, enhance, and refine a production mobile application using **React Native, Expo, TypeScript, and modern React**.

This is a highly hands-on frontend mobile engineering role focused on delivering polished, intuitive, and high-performance experiences across iOS and Android.

You'll join a small, fast-moving engineering team, collaborating directly with technical stakeholders and backend engineers to turn high-fidelity designs into production-ready mobile interfaces.

The ideal candidate has strong React Native expertise, exceptional attention to UI details, and the ability to quickly understand an existing codebase and deliver meaningful improvements from the first week.

This opportunity is particularly well-suited for engineers who enjoy ownership, rapid iteration, clean code, and building high-quality mobile experiences.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Develop, enhance, and maintain production mobile applications using **React Native, Expo, and TypeScript**.

* Develop interactive mobile features involving conversational interfaces, content presentation, and user interactions.
* Ensure smooth animations, transitions, navigation, and native-feeling interactions.
* Build reusable, maintainable React Native components using modern React patterns and hooks.
* Integrate frontend features with backend APIs and collaborate with backend engineers on API contracts.
* Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues, performance bottlenecks, and platform-specific inconsistencies.
* Write clean, well-tested, maintainable, and documented code.
* Deliver small, reviewable commits and participate in code reviews.
* Occasionally contribute to React-based web interfaces.
* Collaborate with engineering stakeholders to clarify requirements, prioritize work, and deliver improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in mobile UI quality, performance, and maintainability.

### **Requirements:**

* **3+ years of professional experience building and shipping production React Native applications.**
* Strong hands-on experience with **React Native**.
* Strong proficiency in **TypeScript** and modern React development.
* Experience working with **Expo** or comparable React Native development workflows.
* Strong understanding of React hooks, component architecture, and modern React patterns.
* Proven ability to implement high-fidelity UI designs.
* Strong attention to mobile UI/UX details, including spacing, typography, animations, and native interactions.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with backend APIs.
* Experience maintaining and enhancing existing production applications.
* Strong understanding of testing and code quality practices.

### **Must Have:**

* **3+ years of production React Native development experience.**
* Strong **TypeScript** proficiency.
* Strong experience with **modern React**, including hooks and component-based architecture.
* Practical experience with **Expo**, or strong React Native experience with the ability to work effectively in an Expo codebase.
* Experience delivering production mobile applications for **iOS and Android**.
* Strong ability to translate high-fidelity designs into polished mobile interfaces.
* Excellent attention to:
  + UI consistency and visual accuracy.
  + Typography and spacing.
  + Animations and transitions.
  + Responsive mobile layouts.
  + Native-feeling user interactions.
* Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs or similar backend services.
* Experience writing clean, maintainable, and testable code.
* Ability to quickly understand and contribute to existing codebases.
* Experience working with code reviews and collaborative development workflows.
* Ability to deliver independently in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Clear communication and reliable availability during agreed working hours.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience with **React 19**.
* Advanced experience with **Expo** and its ecosystem.
* Experience developing map-based or location-aware mobile interfaces.
* Experience with **Mapbox** or **react-native-maps**.
* Experience building conversational interfaces, chat applications, or real-time messaging experiences.
* Experience developing streaming AI or LLM-powered interfaces.
* Experience with **PostHog** or similar product analytics platforms.
* Experience implementing feature flags and analytics instrumentation.
* Experience with **React + Vite** for web applications.
* Experience working with AI coding agents to improve development productivity and code quality.
* Previous experience in startup environments or small engineering teams.
* Experience contributing to fast-moving products with frequent production releases.

Home office;

Competitive compensation based on experience;

Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company;

International Projects;

* Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de painéis e indicadores.

* Pós-graduação em Gestão de TI ou Projetos.

* Comunicação clara e bom relacionamento com outras áreas

REGIME - CLT (REMOTO)

Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais.

A Techne é uma empresa de tecnologia que, diariamente, simplifica a vida das pessoas. Atuamos em duas principais linhas de negócios, cada uma voltada para um segmento de mercado:

Somos apaixonados por inovação e promovemos a conexão entre os times para que, juntos, possamos trabalhar com maior sinergia. Nosso compromisso é gerar valor aos nossos clientes e criar experiências que tornem as rotinas mais simples e fluidas com a utilização de nossas soluções e serviços.

* Mapear e implementar alertas para as jornadas críticas do usuário — fechando lacunas de cobertura críticas e de alta severidade.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a **Lead DevOps Engineer** to run a one-person DevOps function for a multi-tenant SaaS platform in insurance and financial services. You will support ~18 .NET microservices and an Angular SSR UI on Microsoft Azure across dev/demo/UAT/prod in primary and DR regions while enabling 30+ developers across five teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Administer Azure services including App Services, Application Gateway v2 with WAF, Azure Firewall egress rules, Key Vault, Blob Storage, Azure DNS, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
* Maintain AKS-hosted self-hosted build agents to keep CI/CD workflows running reliably
* Implement Infrastructure as Code with ARM templates and PowerShell via shared central pipeline templates used across approximately 20 repositories
* Develop and sustain Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, manage GitHub repositories, rulesets, and branch policies as part of the ADO-to-GitHub migration
* Resolve pipeline failures and reduce throttling-related disruptions
* Analyze production incidents using Application Insights, Kusto, and Kudu diagnostics
* Troubleshoot third-party integrations with insurers and banks across DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, and authentication layers, including egress and whitelisting requests and vendor escalations
* Coordinate change management through ServiceNow CHG records, implementation plans, and TCS task coordination
* Track VM vulnerability remediation with TCS based on Wiz findings, triage Invicti DAST results, and investigate WAF blocks
* Complete client security questionnaires and manage SailPoint access recertification along with PIM/Entra privileged access
* Drive FinOps efforts including Azure cost allocation per tenant and line of business, capacity sizing for large client onboardings, and infrastructure budget input
* Support developer enablement through access requests, app settings propagation across environments, and configuration drift detection

**Requirements**

* Proven DevOps experience of 5+ years supporting production SaaS platforms
* Expert-level knowledge of Azure services including App Services, Application Gateway, WAF, and Azure Firewall
* Hands-on proficiency with Azure Key Vault, Blob Storage, Azure DNS, Application Insights, and Log Analytics
* Strong capability in AKS administration and running self-hosted build agents
* Solid background in Infrastructure as Code using ARM templates and PowerShell
* Demonstrated experience with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and GitHub repository management, rulesets, and branch policies
* Proficiency in incident analysis using Kusto and Kudu diagnostics
* Deep understanding of layered connectivity troubleshooting (DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, auth) for third-party integrations
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow change management processes
* Experience with security and compliance tooling such as Wiz, Invicti DAST, and SailPoint
* Ability to handle FinOps activities including cost allocation and capacity sizing
* Comfort using GitHub Copilot CLI agents and applying DevOps automation workflows
* English proficiency at B2+ (Upper-Intermediate) level

**We offer**

* International projects with top brands
* Work with global teams of highly skilled, diverse peers
* Healthcare benefits
* Employee financial programs
* Paid time off and sick leave
* Upskilling, reskilling and certification courses
* Unlimited access to the LinkedIn Learning library and 22,000+ courses
* Global career opportunities
* Volunteer and community involvement opportunities
* EPAM Employee Groups
* Award-winning culture recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek and LinkedIn

*EPAM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.*

Growth & Engagement Manager (Enterprise Accounts)
jobs.description:
**Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.**

**GET TO KNOW US**

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

**Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!**

  

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are hiring a **Growth & Engagement Manager (Enterprise Accounts)** to our **Revenue** team in **São Paulo**!

You will be the strategic architect behind engagement and adoption programs for Wellhub's most complex enterprise accounts. This is not a traditional operational marketing or customer support role, you will act as a senior internal consultant and trusted advisor to enterprise HR executives, building Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and deploying custom engagement models tailored to workforce demographics. Combining behavioral data, growth experimentation, and AI-driven workflows, your mission is to transform corporate wellbeing culture, remove friction barriers, and directly accelerate paid subscriber growth across thousands of employees.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

* **Enterprise Portfolio Ownership:** Own the wellbeing engagement strategy for top-tier enterprise accounts, designing, launching, and iterating multi-phase activation programs that drive paid subscription adoption and long-term member retention.
* **Strategic HR Advisory & Joint Business Plans:** Co-create and present Joint Business Plans with senior HR and C-level leaders, using portfolio benchmarks, utilization data, and behavioral insights to influence corporate wellbeing investment.
* **Data-Driven Diagnostics & Growth Experimentation:** Track and analyze adoption funnels, reach, and engagement metrics in Tableau, Looker, or Metabase. Identify root causes of underperformance and test tailored segmentation frameworks instead of relying on generic templates.
* **Cross-Functional Orchestration:** Partner closely with Customer Success (CS), User Growth, Sales, and Product to align account priorities, unblock initiatives, and deliver unified client growth roadmaps.
* **Process Scalability & AI Adoption:** Pioneer and implement AI-powered workflows and automation tools to streamline reporting, campaign iteration, and portfolio diagnostics—eliminating operational tasks to focus on strategic execution.
* **Live the mission:** inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

**WHO YOU ARE**

* **Consultative & Growth Background:** Solid experience in Growth Marketing, Customer Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Revenue Strategy, Management Consulting, or Strategic Customer Success within high-growth B2B tech, SaaS, or consultative environments.
* **Enterprise Client-Facing Acumen:** Demonstrated track record of partnering directly with senior corporate decision-makers (HR directors, business leaders) to deliver joint growth initiatives and consultative business reviews.
* **Data Fluency & Problem Framing:** Proven ability to turn complex metrics into actionable insights using BI and analytics tools (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, Amplitude, Power BI, or similar); comfortable navigating ambiguous scenarios and framing hypotheses independently.
* **AI Literacy & Workflow Optimization:** Practical experience integrating generative and agentic AI tools into daily workflows to eliminate operational overhead, analyze data patterns, and accelerate deliverables.
* **Ruthless Prioritization & Builder Mindset:** Proven capacity to manage high client demand by prioritizing high-impact growth levers and driving projects from concept to measurement with complete autonomy.
* **Languages:** Advanced or Fluent English is required for collaboration across Wellhub's global matrix organization.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER YOU**

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

**Our benefits include:**

**WELLHUB:** Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

**WELLZ:** A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

**HEALTHCARE:** Health, dental, and life insurance.

**FLEXIBLE WORK:** As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

**FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:** Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

**PAID TIME OFF:** It's important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

**PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:** Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

**CAREER GROWTH:** Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

**CULTURE:** You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

**Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on** **Instagram** **@lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on** **YouTube****!**

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub**

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos.

  

**#LI-HYBRID**

**Wave 2 – Non-SAP Ecosystems**

Gestão das Workstreams de TI da pavimentação tecnológica do Programa IRB(Re) Suíça, envolvendo o Hyperscale, Sistemas Satélites, SAP BDC, Data Lake e Governança de TI.

Prontidão Regulatória e Conformidade FINMA

Atuar como Focal Point de TI com o Comitê Gestor referente à prontidão e gestão dos riscos associados à obtenção e manutenção da Licença FINMA (Autoridade de Supervisão do Mercado Financeiro Suíço – Circular 2018/3).

**PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ENTREGÁVEIS:**

**Gestão do Programa e Ponto de Não-Retorno**

Liderar o plano mestre do programa, gerenciando marcos críticos (Hard Gates), dependências inter-workstreams e garantindo prazos, escopo e critérios de sucesso.

Conduzir o Comitê Executivo e reportar periodicamente o status ao Comitê de TI do Programa e Grupo Gestor, traduzindo complexidades técnicas e regulatórias em tomadas de decisão estratégicas.

Gerenciar a matriz executiva de riscos do programa sob a abordagem 1-para-N (Preventiva, Mitigatória e Plano de Ação).

Prontidão Regulatória (FINMA / FADP / DORA)

Coordenar com a assessoria jurídico-regulatória internacional (Bär & Karrer AG – B&K) e escritórios locais a validação da arquitetura, TIA (Transfer Impact Assessment), ROPA (Art. 12 FADP) e salvaguardas transfronteiriças (Swiss SCCs).

Assegurar a formalização do Inter-Group Service Agreement (IGSA) entre IRB Brasil e IRB Switzerland AG para cobertura dos serviços compartilhados e fluxos de dados.

**Gestão de Fornecedores Globais (Vendor Management):**

Atuar conjuntamente com gestores das workstreams para acelerar a negociação dos aditivos regulatórios obrigatórios (Swiss Financial Services Addendum – SFSA e Cláusula de Incidentes Cibernéticos em 24h – DORA) com os players globais de TI.

Operacionalizar a assinatura e o envio de Engagement Letters / Letters of Commitment como pontes regulatórias para submissão antecipada do Formulário J perante a FINMA.

**Gestão de Riscos:**

Garantir o monitoramento e respostas aos riscos, através de reuniões de trabalho e Status Report com gestores de cada Workstream, reportando ao Comitê de TI do Programa e Grupo Gestor IRB(Re), com métricas claras de progresso.

**HARD SKILLS (COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS)**

**Gestão de Programas Complexos de TI e Transformação:** Experiência comprovada liderando programas multinacionais e transfronteiriços de grande porte, sendo diferencial a experiência no setor financeiro, de seguros ou resseguros.

**Conhecimento do Ecossistema Regulatório:** Diretrizes de Outsourcing da FINMA (Circular 2018/3 e Lei ISA/VAG Arts. 4 e 5), legislação de Proteção de Dados (FADP / LPD Suíça e GDPR), salvaguardas de transferência internacional (Swiss SCCs, TIA, ROPA) e norma de ciber-resiliência DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act).

**Visão de Arquitetura de Sistemas e ERP Enterprise:** Domínio de programas de implementação SAP (S/4HANA RISE Greenfield, SAP BTP CI, FS-RI/FS-CD, Business Partner), soluções SaaS/Low-Code (Salesforce CRM, OutSystems Claims/Contas, Zendesk ITSM, SAS RTDM) e arquiteturas de Data Lake/ETL (Alteryx, IFRS 17).

**Gestão de TI, Cyber e Cloud Security:** Entendimento de conceitos de arquitetura Zero-Trust, IAM (Entra ID), PAM, PIM e segurança em nuvem (Azure/AWS), além de prática em negociação contratual de TI (MSA, SLA, DPA, SFSA, Cláusulas de Auditoria in-loco).

 **Requisitos e qualificações:**

**Idiomas:** Inglês fluente/avançado mandatório, indispensável para negociação direta com a assessoria suíça B&K, FINMA, SAP Suíça e executivos internacionais

 **Desejável:**

.

jobs.title: Engenheiro(a) de IA – Agentes
jobs.description:
A Omie tem como propósito trazer prosperidade para o ecossistema empreendedor brasileiro. Por isso, buscamos por pessoas com mentalidade de crescimento, valorizando perfis que tenham capacidade de adaptação, senso colaborativo e sejam motivadas pela inovação e pelo aprendizado contínuo.
